## א (id: BDB00001)

א, *Āleph*, first letter; in post B Heb. \= numeral 1 (and so in marg. of printed MT); Āleph (with diaresis) \= 1000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

> \[Str1] אָב v. II. אבה

* **Associated Articles:** II אבה (ID: `BDB00018@BDBHebrewLexicon`)


## אבב (id: BDB00003)

אבב (*fresh, bright*, As. *abâbu* Dlw, AGl.)

> \[Str3] † \[אֵב] **n. \[m.]** freshness, fresh green (LagBN 207 Inf. *ibb;* thence concr., cf. Ar. أَبٌّ; above stem \& mng. better than √ אנב (spring) cf. As. *inbu*, fruit, Aram. אִנְבַּהּ (q. v.) DlHA 65, Pr 114\) עֹדֶנּוּ בְאִבּוֺ *while yet in its freshness* (i.e. אָחוּ, reed) [Jb 8:12](https://ref.ly/Job8:12); concr., pl. *green shoots* בְּאִבֵּי הַנַּחַל Ct [6:11](https://ref.ly/Song6:11) (‖:הֲפָֽרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן הֵנֵצוּ הָֽרִמֹּנִים).

> \[Str24] אָבִיב **n.m.**:[Lv 2:14](https://ref.ly/Lev2:14) **coll.** (LagBN 207 Inf.) **1\.** fresh, young ears of barley [Ex 9:31](https://ref.ly/Exod9:31); indef. [Lv 2:14](https://ref.ly/Lev2:14) קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ ´מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים ליהוה א. **2\.** חֹדֶשׁ הָֽאָבִיב month of ear\-forming, or of growing green, Abib, month of Exodus \& passover, [Ex 13:4](https://ref.ly/Exod13:4), [23:15](https://ref.ly/Exod23:15), [34:18](https://ref.ly/Exod34:18), [34:18](https://ref.ly/Exod34:18) (JE), [Dt 16:1](https://ref.ly/Deut16:1), [16:1](https://ref.ly/Deut16:1) (1st month \= c. April \= הָרִאשֹׁן, ´הַחֹדֶשׁ הָר (q.v.) in P; v. Di [Ex 12:2](https://ref.ly/Exod12:2); \= postexilic נִיסָן q.v.)

> \[Str26] אֲבִגַיִל v. אֲבִיגַיִל sub II. אבה

> \[Str5] אֲבַגְתָא **n. pr. m.** (Pers. cf. בִּגְתָא) eunuch of Ahasuerus [Est 1:10](https://ref.ly/Esth1:10).

* **Associated Passages:** Exodus 9:31; Deuteronomy 16:1; Esther 1:10; Job 8:12; Exodus 23:15; Exodus 12:2; Exodus 34:18; Leviticus 2:14; Song of Songs 6:11; Exodus 13:4
* **Associated Articles:** אֲבִיאָסָף (ID: `BDB00018@BDBHebrewLexicon`)

6:a. III. אבל, אוֺבִיל: on this etym., form ´אוֺ: needs explanation; GFM (privately) queries whether, if genuine, name may not be theophoric (*x* \+ *īl*), poss. err. for אַדְבְּאֵל; or Aram. Aph. from יבל (which in any case may have influenced pronunciation).

## אדן (id: BDB00145)

אדן (mng. disputed; (1\) cf. As. \[*adannu*] *firm, strong;* adv. *adannisû, strongly, exceedingly* DlW \> (2\) Fü. (*a*) *make firm, fasten* (cf. عدن) whence אֶדֶן; (*b*) *determine, command, rule*, whence אָדוֺן; (*3*) Thes Add., MV al. (*a*) intr.*be under, low, inferior* (cf. דּוּן, دان), whence אֶדֶן; (*b*) tr. *put under command, rule over* (cf. דִּין) whence אָדוֺן; v. also (4\) LagM. i. 102, אָדוֺן fr. ادى).

Palestine, exact position unknown, cf. infr.; LXX Σωφηρα, Σωφειρα, Σουφειρ, etc.; [Jb 28:16](https://ref.ly/Job28:16) Ὠφειρ AC, cf. [1 K 22:49](https://ref.ly/1Kgs22:49) A Ὠφειρδε, B om.) place whither Sol.'s ships went fr. Ezion Geber, bringing thence gold [1 K 9:28](https://ref.ly/1Kgs9:28)—cf. [22:49](https://ref.ly/1Kgs22:49)—[2 Ch 8:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr8:18); gold, almug\- (sandal\-?) wood \& gems [10:11](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:11), [10:11](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:11), cf. [2 Ch 9:10](https://ref.ly/2Chr9:10); prob. [1 K 10:22](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:22) ref. to same ships; they came once in three years with gold, silver, ivory, apes \& peacocks (all fr. Ophir ?); [2 Ch 9:21](https://ref.ly/2Chr9:21) makes these ships go to Tarshish (but on Tarshish\-ships, i.e. large, sea\-going vessels, merchantmen, v. [1 K 22:49](https://ref.ly/1Kgs22:49) \& sub תַּרְשִׁישׁ). **3\.** characteristic of fine gold (poet. \& late) ´זְהַב א [1 Ch 29:4](https://ref.ly/1Chr29:4); ´כֶּתֶם א [Is 13:12](https://ref.ly/Isa13:12), [Jb 28:16](https://ref.ly/Job28:16), [Psalm 45:10](https://ref.ly/Ps45:10). **4\.** hence for fine gold itself [Jb 22:24](https://ref.ly/Job22:24) (‖בֶּצֶר).—(If **2** \= **1**, then southern, prob. south\-eastern, Arabia (cf. Di [Gn 10:29](https://ref.ly/Gen10:29)) furnished the gold; and other articles, which point farther E. (e.g. to India, toward which the words קוֺפִים *apes* \& תֻּכִּיִּים *peacocks* seem to lead), were either brought to Ophir by traders, \& so found there by Sol.'s men, or were found elsewhere by the latter, whose cruise may have taken them beyond Ophir, the name of Ophir alone, as source of gold\-supply, being preserved. If (less likely) **1** \& **2** are not the same, the only data for determining loc. of **2** are the articles brought, \& one may look toward India, Ceylon or other islands, or even lower Africa. Particular theories have as yet no adequate support; e.g. (*a*) old city *Supara*, or *Uppara*, in the region of Goa, Malabar coast (cf. LXX supr. **2**, but also **1**; form with Σ said on Copt. authority to denote India, v. JablonskiiOpusc. ed. te Water i. 337; cf. also JosAnt. viii. 6\. 4; in that case its use by LXX may indicate a theory of the location of Ophir); (*b*) peninsula *Malacca;* (*c*) island *Sumatra;* (*d*) *Sofâla*, with city Zimbabye (SE. Africa); (*e*) west coast of Arabia (where gold \& silver formerly found), etc. On these \& other theories, v. Di [Gn 10:29](https://ref.ly/Gen10:29) RiHWB, Herzog, SmithDict. Bib.; cf. GlaserSkizze ii. 367 ff.)
> 
> — אוֺפִיר: WMMAs. u. Eur. 111 identifies with Egypt. *Punt,* on W. coast of Red Sea.

## אחה (id: BDB00317)

אחה (stem assumed for אָח; which however perh. bilit. \& prim, so Thes Rob Ges al.; DlHA 59 prop, *surround, protect;* DlW comp. *aḫu, side.*, ZehnpfundBAS 1\. 510 prop. *belong together,* cf. Schult. Thes. De Goeje in RS Sem 256 N suggests connection with *ḥayy, family, clan*).

## אָחַר (id: BDB00371)

Pa. אֵחַר, Aph. ܐܰܘܚܰܕ, Shaph. ܫܰܘܚܰܪ, Sab. אחַר OsianderZMG 1865, 197; אחַחַר DHMEpigr. Denkm. 34\). † **Qal** once only [Gn 32:5](https://ref.ly/Gen32:5) וָאֵחַר (contr. fr. וָאֶאֱחַר cf. אֵהָב [Pr 8:17](https://ref.ly/Prov8:17))  *and I have tarried* until now. † **Pi.** *Pf.* אֵחַר [Gn 34:19](https://ref.ly/Gen34:19); אֶחֱרוּ Ju [5:28](https://ref.ly/Judg5:28); *Impf.* יְאַחֵר, תְּאַחֵר (3 t. תְּאַחַָר) etc. [Gn 24:56](https://ref.ly/Gen24:56) \+ 9 t.; *Pt.* (־רֵי) מְאַהֲרִים 3 t. **1\.** intensive, *delay, tarry*, abs. Ju [5:28](https://ref.ly/Judg5:28) (‖בּשֵׁשׁ לָבוֺא) [Is 46:13](https://ref.ly/Isa46:13) and my salvation לאֹ תִאַחֵר Hb [2:3](https://ref.ly/Hab2:3), [Psalm 40:18](https://ref.ly/Ps40:18) \= [70:6](https://ref.ly/Ps70:5), [Dn 9:19](https://ref.ly/Dan9:19); with ל \& inf. [Gn 34:19](https://ref.ly/Gen34:19).—[Pr 23:30](https://ref.ly/Prov23:30) מְאַחֲרִים עַל־הַיָּ\+יִן  *those tarrying* over the wine, [Is 5:11](https://ref.ly/Isa5:11) מְאַחֲרֵי בַנֶּשֶׁף, [Psalm 127:2](https://ref.ly/Ps127:2) מְאַחֲרֵי שֶׁבֶת (‖מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם). **2\.** causat. of Qal, *cause one to delay, hinder* [Gn 24:56](https://ref.ly/Gen24:56); *keep back*(\= *bring late*) [Ex 22:28](https://ref.ly/Exod22:28); with ל \& inf. *delay to…* [Dt 23:22](https://ref.ly/Deut23:22) quoted [Ec 5:3](https://ref.ly/Eccl5:3): ellipt. (lit. *shewed, exhibited delay*): on the Kt (? וַיֵּיחַר) v. DrSm.

\[Str335] \[אַי] (أَيٌّ, አይ፡ in Syr. in cpds. as ܐܰܝܟܰܢ *how ?* WSG 120–2; cf. As. *aiu, who? what?*). † **1\. interrog. adv. where? a.** so with sf. אַיֶּכָּה \[a verbal form, v. Sta§ 355 b. 3] [Gn 3:9](https://ref.ly/Gen3:9); אַיּוֺ [Ex 2:20](https://ref.ly/Exod2:20), poet. *where* is he? \= he is nowhere [Jb 14:10](https://ref.ly/Job14:10), [20:7](https://ref.ly/Job20:7) ([Je 37:19](https://ref.ly/Jer37:19) rd. (‖ [Is 37:13](https://ref.ly/Isa37:13) אַיֵּה) [Is 19:12](https://ref.ly/Isa19:12), [Mi 7:10](https://ref.ly/Mic7:10). When used alone, or with other adverbs (v. infr.), it is contracted to אֵי [Gn 4:9](https://ref.ly/Gen4:9), [Dt 32:37](https://ref.ly/Deut32:37), [1 S 26:16](https://ref.ly/1Sam26:16), [Pr 31:4](https://ref.ly/Prov31:4) Qr. (The more usual form is אַיֵּה.) **b.** strengthened by the enclitic זֶה (v. זֶה, **4** אֵי־זֶה:15 *where, then ?* (never of a *person*, exc. [Est 7:5](https://ref.ly/Esth7:5) (late), \& only once [1 K 22:24](https://ref.ly/1Kgs22:24) \[but v. [2 Ch 18:23](https://ref.ly/2Chr18:23)] with a *verb*) [Is 50:1](https://ref.ly/Isa50:1), [66:1](https://ref.ly/Isa66:1), [66:1](https://ref.ly/Isa66:1), [Je 6:16](https://ref.ly/Jer6:16), in indirect qu. [38:24](https://ref.ly/Job38:24). **2\.** prefixed to other adverbs or pron., אֵי imparts to them an interrog. force: thus **a.** אֵי־זֶה *which* (of two or more)? only [Ec 2:3](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:3), [11:6](https://ref.ly/Eccl11:6) (late), in indirect qu. **b.** † אֵי־מִזֶּה *whence ?* (מִזֶּה \= *hence;* v. sub זֶה) [Gn 16:8](https://ref.ly/Gen16:8) אֵי־מִזֶּה בָאתְ [1 S 30:13](https://ref.ly/1Sam30:13), [2 S 1:3](https://ref.ly/2Sam1:3), [1:13](https://ref.ly/2Sam1:13), [Jb 2:2](https://ref.ly/Job2:2); in indirect qu. Similar in usage, though not etym. akin, are لَيْسَ, לַיִת, ܠܰܝܬ, አልቦ፡, prop. ‘there is *nought of* …’ sq. a subst. or a pron. suffix (אֵינֶנִּי \[*verbal* form, Ges§ 100, 5; 152, 1 c], אֵינְךָ, אֵינֵךְ, אֵינֶנּוּ, אֵינֶנָּה, אֵינְכֶם, אֵינָם, also [Psalm 59:14](https://ref.ly/Ps59:14) אֵינֵ֫מוֺ, [73:5](https://ref.ly/Ps73:5) אֵינֵ֫ימוֺ): twice abnormally, in late Heb., a nom. אֵין אֲנִי, אֵין אֲנַחְנוּ [Ne 4:17](https://ref.ly/Neh4:17) (so sts. לַיִת, ܠܰܝܬ, NöM. p. 295\); once, incorrectly, את [Hg 2:17](https://ref.ly/Hag2:17). **a.** denying existence absolutely [Is 44:6](https://ref.ly/Isa44:6), [47:10](https://ref.ly/Isa47:10) אֵין רֹאָנִי *there is none* that seeth me, lit. *nought of* one seeing me! אֵין עוֺד *there is none* else [Dt 4:39](https://ref.ly/Deut4:39), [1 K 8:60](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:60), [Is 45:5](https://ref.ly/Isa45:5), [45:6](https://ref.ly/Isa45:6), [45:18](https://ref.ly/Isa45:18), [45:22](https://ref.ly/Isa45:22). **b.** more commonly, in a limited sense, *there is none here* or  *at hand* [Ex 2:12](https://ref.ly/Exod2:12) and he saw כִּי־אֵין אִישׁ that *there was no* man (sc. there), [Nu 21:5](https://ref.ly/Num21:5); [Gn 5:24](https://ref.ly/Gen5:24) וְאֵינֶנּוּ and he *was not* (of Enoch's disappearance from earth) [42:13](https://ref.ly/Gen42:13) one (*cas. pend.* as oft.), *he is not,* v:[36](https://ref.ly/Gen42:36); oft. \= *is* (or *has*) *vanished* [Gn 37:30](https://ref.ly/Gen37:30), [1 K 20:40](https://ref.ly/1Kgs20:40), [Is 17:14](https://ref.ly/Isa17:14), [Psalm 37:10](https://ref.ly/Ps37:10), [103:16](https://ref.ly/Ps103:16), [Jb 8:22](https://ref.ly/Job8:22), [24:24](https://ref.ly/Job24:24), [27:19](https://ref.ly/Job27:19). **c.** with the sense determined by a predic. following: [Gn 37:29](https://ref.ly/Gen37:29) Joseph *was not in the pit,* [41:39](https://ref.ly/Gen41:39) \+ oft.; [Ex 5:10](https://ref.ly/Exod5:10) אֵינֶנִּי נֹתֵן לָכֶם תֶּבֶן *I am not giving* you straw; and so often with particip. where duration has to be expressed [Gn 39:23](https://ref.ly/Gen39:23), [Dt 21:18](https://ref.ly/Deut21:18), [Is 1:15](https://ref.ly/Isa1:15), [Je 7:16](https://ref.ly/Jer7:16), or intention [Gn 20:7](https://ref.ly/Gen20:7) אֵינְךָ מֵשִׁיב דַּע ֭ אִם if thou *art not restoring* her, know [43:5](https://ref.ly/Gen43:5), [Ex 8:17](https://ref.ly/Exod8:17), [33:15](https://ref.ly/Exod33:15) (idiomatically, after אם; v. Dr§ 137\) Ju [12:3](https://ref.ly/Judg12:3). Foll. once pleon. by יֵשׁ [Psalm 135:17](https://ref.ly/Ps135:17). Treated as a *mere* part. of negation, אֵין may vary its position in the sentence, the subst. which should strictly stand in the genitive being not only separated from it by a little word, as בּוֺ [Gn 37:24](https://ref.ly/Gen37:24), לוֺ [Ex 22:1](https://ref.ly/Exod22:1), שָׁם [Ex 12:30](https://ref.ly/Exod12:30), גַּם [Psalm 14:3](https://ref.ly/Ps14:3), etc., but even for emphasis *prefixed* to it, as [Gn 19:31](https://ref.ly/Gen19:31), [40:8](https://ref.ly/Gen40:8) וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֺ [41:15](https://ref.ly/Gen41:15), [Ex 5:16](https://ref.ly/Exod5:16), Ju [13:9](https://ref.ly/Judg13:9), [14:6](https://ref.ly/Judg14:6), [16:15](https://ref.ly/Judg16:15), [19:1](https://ref.ly/Judg19:1) (so MI24): if however it be thus brought to the end of a sentence, or be disconnected with what follows, it stands in the absol. form, as [Gn 2:5](https://ref.ly/Gen2:5) ואדם אַיִן לעבד האדמה and man *there was none* to till the ground, [Lv 26:37](https://ref.ly/Lev26:37) וְרֹדֵף אָיִן [Nu 20:5](https://ref.ly/Num20:5), [2 K 19:3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs19:3), [Ho 13:4](https://ref.ly/Hos13:4), [Mi 7:2](https://ref.ly/Mic7:2). **d.** sometimes the subj. has to be supplied from the context: thus (α) † [1 S 9:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam9:4) and they passed through the land of Shaalim וָאַיִן *and they* (the asses) *were not* (lit. *and nought!*), esp. after vbs. of *waiting* or *seeking* [Is 59:11](https://ref.ly/Isa59:11), [Psalm 69:21](https://ref.ly/Ps69:21), [Jb 3:9](https://ref.ly/Job3:9); [Is 41:17](https://ref.ly/Isa41:17), . Ez [7:25](https://ref.ly/Ezek7:25), [Pr 14:6](https://ref.ly/Prov14:6); [13:4](https://ref.ly/Prov13:4); [20:4](https://ref.ly/Prov20:4). (β) † [Ex 17:7](https://ref.ly/Exod17:7) is ´י in the midst of us :אִם־אָֽיִן *or not ?* [Nu 13:20](https://ref.ly/Num13:20). (γ) † Ju [4:20](https://ref.ly/Judg4:20) :וְאָמַרְתְּ אָֽיִן then thou shalt say, *There is not*, [1 K 18:10](https://ref.ly/1Kgs18:10), [1 S 10:14](https://ref.ly/1Sam10:14). Dr) [2 K 2:10](https://ref.ly/2Kgs2:10), [Jb 33:33](https://ref.ly/Job33:33). **e.** with subj. not expressed, once (late), [Dn 8:5](https://ref.ly/Dan8:5) וְאֵין נֹגֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ and (it) *was not touching* the earth. **f.** once, [Jb 35:15](https://ref.ly/Job35:15) with the finite vb.; but rd. here כִּי אֵין פֹּקֵד (the usage of لَيْسَ, cited by De, does not justify the anomaly in Heb.) [Je 38:5](https://ref.ly/Jer38:5) the impf. may be due to the fact that no ptcp. of יָכֹל was in use, and a relat. must be tacitly supplied: ‘The king *is not* (one that) can do aught against you.’ On [Ex 3:2](https://ref.ly/Exod3:2) see Ges§ 52, 2 R. 6; Ew§ 169 d. **3\.** ´אֵין לְ, with subst., or pron., *there is (was) not to*…\=…*have, has, had,* etc. *not:* [Gn 11:30](https://ref.ly/Gen11:30) אֵין לָהּ וָלָד *she had no* child, [Nu 27:9](https://ref.ly/Num27:9) וְאִם־אֵין לוֺ בַּת and if *he have no* daughter \+ oft.; with a ptcp. [Dt 22:27](https://ref.ly/Deut22:27), [Je 14:16](https://ref.ly/Jer14:16), [30:17](https://ref.ly/Jer30:17), [49:5](https://ref.ly/Jer49:5), [50:32](https://ref.ly/Jer50:32), [Psalm 142:5](https://ref.ly/Ps142:5), [La 1:2](https://ref.ly/Lam1:2), [1:9](https://ref.ly/Lam1:9), [1:17](https://ref.ly/Lam1:17); [Ex 22:2](https://ref.ly/Exod22:2) אִם־אֵין לוֺ if he *have nought*, [Dn 9:26](https://ref.ly/Dan9:26) ואין לו and *have nought* (or *none*). **4\.** in circumst. clauses (Dr§ 164\):—(*a*) [Ex 21:11](https://ref.ly/Exod21:11) she shall go out free אֵין כָּסֶף *without money*, [22:9](https://ref.ly/Exod22:9) אֵין רֹאֶה *none seeing it,* [Nu 11:6](https://ref.ly/Num11:6), [Is 47:1](https://ref.ly/Isa47:1), [Je 2:32](https://ref.ly/Jer2:32), [Ho 3:4](https://ref.ly/Hos3:4), [7:11](https://ref.ly/Hos7:11), [Psalm 32:9](https://ref.ly/Ps32:9), [88:5](https://ref.ly/Ps88:5) \+ . ## אישׁ (id: BDB00435)

אישׁ, אושׁ (Stem assumed in Thes for אִישׁ; existence \& mng. somewhat dub. Thes (Add) \& most derive אִישׁ fr. \[אִנְשְׁ] √ אנשׁ (q. v.) In favour are pl. אֲנָשִׁים, fem. אִשָּׁה \= \[אִנְשָׁה], lack of proven √ אישׁ, \& lack of clear parallels for אישׁ in cogn. lang. Against the deriv. of אִישׁ fr. *insû* is the vocalization (י—ִ, and that fully written, not —ֵ), maintained even with suff., the (rare) pl. אִישִׁים, the impossibility of deriving אִישׁ \& אִשָּׁה from same √ (אִשָּׁה fr. انث), the existence of אֱנוֺשׁ as parallel form, and the (exceptional) parallel Aram. איש (Inscr. of Carpentras), also Ar. إِيسَانٌ (cf. Frey) ‖ إِنْسٌ; MI, SI, Ph. אש are not decisive; Sab. has both אסם \& אנסם; the former app. \= אִישׁ, the latter אֱנוֺשׁ; but on former cf. DHMZK 1884, 360 \& Sab. Denkm.:37\. On the whole, probability seems to favour √ אישׁ; Thes gave mng. *be strong;* DlHA 9, Pr 161 comp. As. *isûanu, strong* (cf. Dlw. p. 244\), \& n.pr. יְהוֺאָשׁ; cf. also PrätLOPh. Feb. 1884; otherwise DHMl. e. \& ZMG 1883, 330 \& esp. NöZMG 1886, 739 LagBN 68; cf. also Wetzst in DePsalmen, ed. 4, p. 888 al. v. also אנשׁ, אֱנוֺשׁ).

35:b. אִישׁ, 1\.5 from bottom: אֲנָשִׁים Ez [24:17](https://ref.ly/Ezek24:17), [24:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek24:22) is textual error; We (ap. Sm) אֲנֻשִׁים; ToyHpt אוֺנִים ([Ho 9:4](https://ref.ly/Hos9:4)).

[Psalm 62:2](https://ref.ly/Ps62:2) etc. [Jb 14:22](https://ref.ly/Job14:22); [Psalm 37:8](https://ref.ly/Ps37:8) fret not thyself אַךְ לְהָרֵעַ (which leadeth) *only* to do evil, [Pr 11:24](https://ref.ly/Prov11:24) he that withholdeth more than is meet אַךְ לְמַחְסוֺר (tendeth) *only* to penury, [14:23](https://ref.ly/Prov14:23), [21:5](https://ref.ly/Prov21:5), [22:16](https://ref.ly/Prov22:16); (β) attaching itself closely to the foll. word (usually an adj., rarely a verb), *only,* i.e. *exclusively, altogether, utterly* [Dt 16:15](https://ref.ly/Deut16:15) and thou shalt be אַךְ שָמֵחַ *altogether* rejoicing, [28:29](https://ref.ly/Deut28:29) (cf. v:[33](https://ref.ly/Deut28:33) רַק) [Isa 16:7](https://ref.ly/Isa16:7) אַךְ נְכָאִים *utterly* stricken, [19:11](https://ref.ly/Isa19:11), [Je 16:19](https://ref.ly/Jer16:19) *nought but* lies, [32:30](https://ref.ly/Jer32:30), [Ho 12:12](https://ref.ly/Hos12:12), [Jb 19:13](https://ref.ly/Job19:13) אַךְ זָרוּ are *wholly* estranged (with play on אַכְזָר *cruel*). **c.** as an adv. of time (with inf. abs.), twice: [Gn 27:30](https://ref.ly/Gen27:30) וְעֵשָו בָּא…אַךְ יָצאֹ יָצָא יַעֲקֹב *only just* (or *scarcely*) had Jacob gone out,…and (\= when) Esau came in, Ju [7:19](https://ref.ly/Judg7:19).—וְאַח thrice : [Gn 9:5](https://ref.ly/Gen9:5) *and only* (second limitation of v:[3](https://ref.ly/Gen9:3)); [Nu 22:20](https://ref.ly/Num22:20) *but only;* [Jos 22:19](https://ref.ly/Josh22:19) *but howbeit.*
> 
>  *Note*.—In some passages the affirmative and restrictive senses agree equally with the context; and authorities read the Hebrew differently. Thus *only \= nought but, altogether*, is adopted by Ges Ew Hi De in [Psalm 23:6](https://ref.ly/Ps23:6), [62:10](https://ref.ly/Ps62:10), [73:1](https://ref.ly/Ps73:1), [73:13](https://ref.ly/Ps73:13); by Ew Hi De in [39:6](https://ref.ly/Ps39:6), [39:7](https://ref.ly/Ps39:7) (Che *surely*); by Ges Ew De in [39:12](https://ref.ly/Ps39:12) (but Hi Che *surely*); by Ew Hi in [73:18](https://ref.ly/Ps73:18) (De Che *surely*); by Ges Hi De in [139:11](https://ref.ly/Ps139:11) (Ew *doch*). [Isa 45:14](https://ref.ly/Isa45:14) Ges Ew Hi Di *only;* but De Che *of a truth*.

## אָכֵן (id: BDB00459)

\[Str403] † אָכֵן (perh. from אַח; cf. Aram. דֵּח \& דִּכֵּן) **adv.** with strong asseverative force: **a.** surely, truly, esp. at beginning of a speech (stronger \& more decided than אַח) [Gn 28:16](https://ref.ly/Gen28:16), [Ex 2:14](https://ref.ly/Exod2:14), [1 S 15:32](https://ref.ly/1Sam15:32), [Is 40:7](https://ref.ly/Isa40:7), [45:15](https://ref.ly/Isa45:15), [Je 3:23](https://ref.ly/Jer3:23), [3:23](https://ref.ly/Jer3:23), [4:10](https://ref.ly/Jer4:10), [8:8](https://ref.ly/Jer8:8). In [1 K 11:2](https://ref.ly/1Kgs11:2) אָבֵן stands unusually; and פֶּ־ן (cf. LXX SyrVer Targum) should prob. be read (so Klo). **b.** emphasizing a contrast, *but indeed, but in fact,* esp. after אָמַרְתִּי *I said* or *thought,* expressing the reality, in opp. to what had been wrongly imagined, [Is 49:4b](https://ref.ly/Isa49:4) (opp. to va) [53:4](https://ref.ly/Isa53:4) (opp. to v:[3](https://ref.ly/Isa53:3) end) [Je 3:20](https://ref.ly/Jer3:20) (opp. to the expectation v:[19](https://ref.ly/Jer3:19) b) [Zp 3:7](https://ref.ly/Zeph3:7) b, [Psalm 31:23](https://ref.ly/Ps31:23) b (opp. to v:[23a](https://ref.ly/Ps31:23)) [66:19](https://ref.ly/Ps66:19), [82:7](https://ref.ly/Ps82:7) (opp. to v:[6](https://ref.ly/Ps82:6)) [Jb 32:8](https://ref.ly/Job32:8) (opp. to v:[7](https://ref.ly/Job32:7)).

* **Associated Passages:** Job 32:7; Jeremiah 3:20; Psalms 66:19; Psalms 82:7; Psalms 82:6; Isaiah 45:15; Jeremiah 3:23; Exodus 2:14; Isaiah 49:4; Genesis 28:16; Psalms 31:23; Job 32:8; Zephaniah 3:7; Isaiah 53:4; Jeremiah 3:19; Jeremiah 4:10; 1 Kings 11:2; Jeremiah 8:8; 1 Samuel 15:32; Isaiah 53:3; Isaiah 40:7


## אָכַף (id: BDB00460)

\[Str404] † אָכַף **vb.** press, urge (Mish. *id.,* Aram. ܐܶܟܰܦ *be urgent,* cf. ܐܘܽܟܦܳܐ, Ar. إِكَافٌ *saddle*);—**Qal** *Pf.* [Pr 16:26](https://ref.ly/Prov16:26) עָלָיו פִָּיהוּ ´א (‖נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָֽמְלָה לוֺ) i.e. his hunger impels him to work.

> \[Str405] † \[אֶ֫כֶף] **n.m.** pressure, sf. אַכְפִּי [Jb 33:7](https://ref.ly/Job33:7) (LXX al. rd. כַּפִּי cf. [13:21](https://ref.ly/Job13:21), but cf. Di).

* **Associated Passages:** Job 13:21; Proverbs 16:26; Job 33:7

I. אַל (\= اَلْ, Ar. article, preserved perh. in following words derived by Hebrews from (or through) Arabic\-speaking tribes; cf. Eng. *algebra, Alhambra, alkali, alcohol, alcove,* etc.)

> \[Str417] † אֶלְגָּבִישׁ **n.\[m.]** hail (\= Ar. أَلْجِبْسُ *gypsum;* cf. sub גבשׁ) ´אַבְנֵי א Ez [13:11](https://ref.ly/Ezek13:11), [13:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek13:13), [38:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek38:22).

Ophir); cf. v:[11](https://ref.ly/2Chr9:11), vid. foll.

> \[Str484] † אַלְמֻגִּים **n.\[m.]pl.** *id.* עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים [1 K 10:11](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:11), [10:12](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:12) (fr. Ophir); ´הָא ´ע [1 K 10:12](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:12).

> \[Str486] † אַלְמוֺדָד **n.pr.** of South\-Arab. people (but prob. rd. אֵל (Sab., *god*) for אַל, cf. Di [Gn 10:26](https://ref.ly/Gen10:26), \& GlasSk. ii. 280 *God is loved* (?)) [Gn 10:26](https://ref.ly/Gen10:26), [1 Ch 1:20](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:20).
> 
> — אַלְמוֺדָד: add GlassSkizze ii. 425\. 435\.

> \[Str510] † אַלְקוּם band of soldiers (\= Ar. القَومُ, *people;* so E. Castle, Thes etc., cf. CheJob \& Sol. 175; \> text. error for אֱלֽהִים Hi cf. Now) [Pr 30:31](https://ref.ly/Prov30:31).

## II אַל (id: BDB00472)

\[Str408] II. אַל **adv. of negation** (so Ph. e.g. CIS i.:3, 4\.5\.8, BAram., Sab. (DHMZMG 1875, 596\), and in the Eth. አልቦ፡ *albo, is not*), denying however, not objectively as a fact (like לאֹ οὐ), but subjectively as a wish (like μή), expressing therefore a *deprecation* or *prohibition:* **a.** (*a*) with a verb, which is then always an impf. (never an imperative), by preference in the cohort. or jussive mood, where this is in use, and may be of any person or number; [Gn 15:1](https://ref.ly/Gen15:1) and often אַל־תִּירָא *fear not!* [22:12](https://ref.ly/Gen22:12) אַל־תִּשְׁלַח יָֽדְךָ *put not forth* thy hand, [37:27](https://ref.ly/Gen37:27) וְיָדֵנוּ אַל־תְּהִי־בוֺ and *let not* our hand *be* upon him, [21:16](https://ref.ly/Gen21:16) אַל־אֶרְאֶה *let me not* look upon the death of the lad! [Psalm 25:2](https://ref.ly/Ps25:2) אַל־אֵבוֺשָׁה *let* me *not be* ashamed; with 1 pl. (rare) [2 S 13:25](https://ref.ly/2Sam13:25), [Je 18:18](https://ref.ly/Jer18:18), [Jon 1:14](https://ref.ly/Jonah1:14). In an imprecation: [Gn 49:4](https://ref.ly/Gen49:4) אַל־תּוֺתַר have not thou the excellency! [Psalm 109:12](https://ref.ly/Ps109:12), [Jb 3:4](https://ref.ly/Job3:4), [3:6](https://ref.ly/Job3:6). Sometimes strengthened by נָא : [Gn 13:8](https://ref.ly/Gen13:8), [18:3](https://ref.ly/Gen18:3) al. (*b*) without a verb, (α) [2 S 1:21](https://ref.ly/2Sam1:21) *let* (there be) *not* dew \& *not* rain upon you! [Is 62:6](https://ref.ly/Isa62:6), [Psalm 83:1](https://ref.ly/Ps83:1). (β) used absol., in deprecation [Gn 19:18](https://ref.ly/Gen19:18), [2 S 13:16](https://ref.ly/2Sam13:16) (v. sub אוֺדָה) [2 K 3:13](https://ref.ly/2Kgs3:13), [4:16](https://ref.ly/2Kgs4:16), [6:27](https://ref.ly/2Kgs6:27) (v. RVm: but possibly to be expl. by Dr§ 152 iii; so Th Ke: hardly as Ew§ 355 b) [Ru 1:13](https://ref.ly/Ruth1:13) אַל בְּנֹתַי *Nay,* my daughters, cf. Ju [19:23](https://ref.ly/Judg19:23); (γ) after a preceding imper. Am 5:l4, [Jo 2:13](https://ref.ly/Joel2:13), [Pr 8:10](https://ref.ly/Prov8:10), a juss. [27:2](https://ref.ly/Prov27:2), an inf. abs. [27:2](https://ref.ly/Prov27:2). (χ) in poetry אַל sometimes expresses vividly the emotion or sympathy of the poet (v. Dr§ 56–8\); [Is 2:9](https://ref.ly/Isa2:9) וְאַל־תִּשָּא לָהֶם and *forgive* them *not!* (with a touch of passion), [Psalm 41:3](https://ref.ly/Ps41:3), [Pr 3:25](https://ref.ly/Prov3:25), [Jb 5:22](https://ref.ly/Job5:22); [Psalm 34:6](https://ref.ly/Ps34:6) (but LXX SyrVer Ew Che here rd. וּפְנֵיכֶם, prob. rightly); [50:3](https://ref.ly/Ps50:3) a may our God come וְאַ־ל יֶ֫חֱשָרשׁ and *not be* silent! (the psalmist identifying himself with a spectator of the scene v:[2](https://ref.ly/Ps50:2), v:[3](https://ref.ly/Ps50:3) b\-c) [121:3](https://ref.ly/Ps121:3) (contrast v:[4](https://ref.ly/Ps121:4) לאֹ) [Je 46:6](https://ref.ly/Jer46:6) \+. **b.** once [Pr 12:28](https://ref.ly/Prov12:28) joined closely to a subst. (cf. לאֹ **2** *b*) to express with emph. its negation: In the way of righteousness is life, and in the pathway therecf אַל־מָוֶת there is *no\-death!* i.e. *immortality.* **c.** once [Jb 24:25](https://ref.ly/Job24:25) used poet. as a subst., And bring my words לְאַל to *nought!*—N.B. [1 S 27:10](https://ref.ly/1Sam27:10) אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֺם, אַל with the pf. is against all analogy; and either אֶל־מִי (with LXX. Vulgate), or better אָן *whither?* (with SyrVer Targum : v. [1 S 10:14](https://ref.ly/1Sam10:14)) must be read.

## אֶל (id: BDB00473)

\[Str413] אֶל (nearly always followed by Makkeph), poet. אֱלֵי (cf. עֲלֵי, עֲדֵי), but only in Job († [3:22](https://ref.ly/Job3:22), [5:26](https://ref.ly/Job5:26), [15:22](https://ref.ly/Job15:22), [29:19](https://ref.ly/Job29:19)), with suff. אֵלַי, אֵלֶיךָ, אֵלַיִךְ, etc. אֵלֵינוּ, אֲלֵיכֶם \& (5 t.) אֲלֵכֶם, אֲלֵיהֶם \& אֲלֵהֶם (both very often); once אֵלֵימוֺ [Psalm 2:5](https://ref.ly/Ps2:5), אֲלֵיהֶן, once אֲלֵהֶן [Ex 1:19](https://ref.ly/Exod1:19) (As. *ilî*, Ar. إِلَى), **prep.** denoting motion to or direction towards (whether physical or mental). **1\.** of motion *to* or *unto* a person or place [Gn 2:19](https://ref.ly/Gen2:19), [2:22](https://ref.ly/Gen2:22), [3:19](https://ref.ly/Gen3:19), [8:9](https://ref.ly/Gen8:9), [14:22](https://ref.ly/Gen14:22), [16:9](https://ref.ly/Gen16:9) etc., after every kind of verb expressing motion (בּוֺא, הָלַךְ, יָצָא etc.) So with נָתַן *to give* (though ל is here more common) [Gn 21:14](https://ref.ly/Gen21:14), [35:4](https://ref.ly/Gen35:4), [Dt 13:2](https://ref.ly/Deut13:2) \+ ; מָכַר *to sell* [37:36](https://ref.ly/Gen37:36), etc. Metaph. [Je 2:19](https://ref.ly/Jer2:19) וְלאֹ פַחְדָּתִי אֵלַיִךְ and that my fear (cometh) not *unto* thee (cf. [Jb 31:23](https://ref.ly/Job31:23)).—Peculiarly [Gn 6:16](https://ref.ly/Gen6:16) אֶל אַמָּה *unto* the length of a cubit, etc. And metaph. in the phrase גִּיל(אֱלֵ־י)אֶ־ל *unto* exultation † [Ho 9:11](https://ref.ly/Hos9:11), [Jb 3:22](https://ref.ly/Job3:22). Once, exceptionally (si vera 1\.) \= *even:* [Jb 5:5](https://ref.ly/Job5:5) וְאֶל־מִצִּגִּים יִקָּחֵהוּ and *even* out of thorns he taketh it. Sometimes pregnant, as [Is 66:17](https://ref.ly/Isa66:17), [Je 41:7](https://ref.ly/Jer41:7) זָנָה אֶל commit whoredom (by going) *to* [Nu 25:1](https://ref.ly/Num25:1), Ez [16:26](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:26), [16:28](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:28), [16:29](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:29); דָּרֵשׁ אֶל seek (by resorting) *to* one (sc. for oracles) [Dt 18:11](https://ref.ly/Deut18:11), [Is 8:19](https://ref.ly/Isa8:19), [11:10](https://ref.ly/Isa11:10) \+ ; חָבַר אֶל join together (\& come) *unto* [Gn 14:3](https://ref.ly/Gen14:3); הִשְׁכִּים אֶל rise early (and go) *to* [19:27](https://ref.ly/Gen19:27), [24:11](https://ref.ly/Gen24:11) הִבְרִיח אֶל made to kneel down *at;* [47:18](https://ref.ly/Gen47:18) תַּם אֶל i.e. has been made over *to;* פָּחַד אֶל to come in fear *to* [Hos 3:5](https://ref.ly/Hos3:5), [Mi 7:17](https://ref.ly/Mic7:17). Opp. is מִן, as מִן־הַקָּצֶה אֶל־הַקָּצֶה from end *to* end [Ex 26:28](https://ref.ly/Exod26:28); מִפֶּה אֶל־פֶּה [Ezr 9:11](https://ref.ly/Ezra9:11) (syn. [2 K 21:16](https://ref.ly/2Kgs21:16) פֶּה לָפֶה). And of time (rare) מֵעֵת אֶל־עֵת † [1 Ch 9:25](https://ref.ly/1Chr9:25); מִיּוֺם אֶל־יוֺם † [Nu 30:15](https://ref.ly/Num30:15) (P) [1 Ch 16:23](https://ref.ly/1Chr16:23) (in the ‖ [Psalm 96:2](https://ref.ly/Ps96:2) מִיּוֺם לְיוֺם).

 **2\.** Where the limit is actually entered, *into,* [Gn 6:18](https://ref.ly/Gen6:18) and thou shalt enter *into* the ark [7:1](https://ref.ly/Gen7:1), [19:3](https://ref.ly/Gen19:3), [41:21](https://ref.ly/Gen41:21), [42:17](https://ref.ly/Gen42:17); \& so after verbs of throwing, casting, putting [37:22](https://ref.ly/Gen37:22) (הִשְׁלִיךְ) [39:20](https://ref.ly/Gen39:20) וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ אֶל־בֵּית הַסֹּהַר put him *into* the prison house, [Ex 28:30](https://ref.ly/Exod28:30) ([Lv 8:8](https://ref.ly/Lev8:8)) [Dt 23:25](https://ref.ly/Deut23:25); so after קָבַר to bury [Gn 23:19](https://ref.ly/Gen23:19), [25:9](https://ref.ly/Gen25:9), [49:29](https://ref.ly/Gen49:29); שָחַט to squeeze [40:11](https://ref.ly/Gen40:11); מָחָה to blot out [Nu 5:23](https://ref.ly/Num5:23), etc.; metaph. [Gn 6:6](https://ref.ly/Gen6:6) was pained *into* or *unto* his heart, שָם אֶל־לֵב, הֵשִׁיב to place, bring. *into* ( \= lay *to*) heart [Dt 4:39](https://ref.ly/Deut4:39), [2 S 19:20](https://ref.ly/2Sam19:20) al. In connexion with a number or multitude *into* which something enters, *in among:* [1 S 10:22](https://ref.ly/1Sam10:22) behold he had hid himself אֶל־הַכֵּלִים *in among* the baggage, [Je 4:3](https://ref.ly/Jer4:3) sow not אֶל־קֹצִים *in among* thorns. **3\.** Of direction *towards* anything: (*a*) of physical acts or states, as [Gn 30:40](https://ref.ly/Gen30:40) נָתַן פְּנֵי הַצּאֹן אֶל, [39:7](https://ref.ly/Gen39:7) נָשָא עֵינָיו אֶל, [Ex 25:20](https://ref.ly/Exod25:20), [Nu 6:26](https://ref.ly/Num6:26), נָשָא פָנָיו אֶל ([2 K 9:32](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:32) differently), [24:1](https://ref.ly/2Kgs24:1) שָׁת פָּנָיו אֶל, [Jos 8:18](https://ref.ly/Josh8:18), [Psalm 28:2](https://ref.ly/Ps28:2), [1 K 8:29](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:29), [8:30](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:30) (to pray *towards*) v:[38](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:38); pregn. חָרֵד אֶל to tremble (turning) *to* [Gn 42:28](https://ref.ly/Gen42:28), תָּמַהּ אֶל to, wonder (turning) *towards* [Gn 43:33](https://ref.ly/Gen43:33), [Is 13:8](https://ref.ly/Isa13:8), פָּחַד אֶל [Je 36:16](https://ref.ly/Jer36:16): without a vb. פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים face *to* face [Gn 32:31](https://ref.ly/Gen32:31) \+ ; פֶּה אֶל־פֶּה [Nu 12:8](https://ref.ly/Num12:8); כִּי־אֵינֶנּוּ אֵלַי [Gn 31:5](https://ref.ly/Gen31:5) the face of Laban, that he is not *toward* me; ´אֶל־פ ´עֵינֵי י the eyes of ´י are *towards*…[Psalm 34:16](https://ref.ly/Ps34:16) (cf. [33:18](https://ref.ly/Ps33:18)). (*b*) with words such as אָמַרto say *to* [Gn 3:1](https://ref.ly/Gen3:1) \+ oft., דִּבֶּר [8:15](https://ref.ly/Gen8:15) \+ oft., קָרָא [19:5](https://ref.ly/Gen19:5), הִחְפַּלֵּל [20:17](https://ref.ly/Gen20:17) etc., שָׁמַע to hearken *to* [16:11](https://ref.ly/Gen16:11), הִלֵּל to praise *to* [12:15](https://ref.ly/Gen12:15) (cf. Ez [13:19](https://ref.ly/Ezek13:19) חִלֵּל אֶל to profane *to*), הִזְכִּיר [40:14](https://ref.ly/Gen40:14). (*c*) with words expressing the direction of the mind, as קִוָּה *to wait* [Psalm 27:14](https://ref.ly/Ps27:14) \+ ; יִחַל *to hope* [Is 51:5](https://ref.ly/Isa51:5); נָשָא נֶפֶשׁ אֶל to lift up the soul (i.e. set the desire) *towards* [Dt 24:15](https://ref.ly/Deut24:15), Psalm 25:l; שָם לֵב אֶל, שָׁת to set the heart (mind) *to* [Ex 9:21](https://ref.ly/Exod9:21) al.; לָמַד אֶל to accustom oneself *to* [Je 10:2](https://ref.ly/Jer10:2); חָרֵד אֶל to shew fear *towards* [2 K 4:13](https://ref.ly/2Kgs4:13); [Gn 43:30](https://ref.ly/Gen43:30); [Dt 28:32](https://ref.ly/Deut28:32) and thy eyes כָּלוֺת אֲלֵיהֶם failing (with longing) *towards* them, [La 4:17](https://ref.ly/Lam4:17); [Is 63:15](https://ref.ly/Isa63:15), [2 S 3:8](https://ref.ly/2Sam3:8), [1 K 14:13](https://ref.ly/1Kgs14:13), [Psalm 40:6](https://ref.ly/Ps40:6); alone, as predic., *directed* or *disposed towards,* [Gn 3:16](https://ref.ly/Gen3:16), [4:7](https://ref.ly/Gen4:7), [2 K 6:11](https://ref.ly/2Kgs6:11) who of ours *is towards* (i.e. favours) the king of Syria? [Ho 3:3](https://ref.ly/Hos3:3) וְגַם־אֲנִי :אֵלָֽיִח Ez [36:9](https://ref.ly/Ezek36:9), [Hg 2:17](https://ref.ly/Hag2:17), [Je 15:1](https://ref.ly/Jer15:1) (אֵין נַפְשִׁי אֶל). **4\.** Where the motion or direction implied appears from the context to be of a hostile character, אֶל \= *against:* [Gn 4:8](https://ref.ly/Gen4:8) אֶל־הֶבֶל ´וַיָּקָם קand Cain rose up *against* Abel (so [1 S 24:8](https://ref.ly/1Sam24:8)) [22:12](https://ref.ly/1Sam22:12), [Ex 14:5](https://ref.ly/Exod14:5), [Nu 32:14](https://ref.ly/Num32:14); with נִקְבַּץ [Jos 10:6](https://ref.ly/Josh10:6), הָלַךְ Ju [1:10](https://ref.ly/Judg1:10), [20:30](https://ref.ly/Judg20:30); with בָּא of calamity, etc., coming *to* or *upon* any one [Gn 42:21](https://ref.ly/Gen42:21), Ju [9:57](https://ref.ly/Judg9:57), [1 S 2:34](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:34), [1 K 14:10](https://ref.ly/1Kgs14:10) \+ ; [Is 2:4](https://ref.ly/Isa2:4), [3:8](https://ref.ly/Isa3:8) their tongue and doings are ´אֶל־י [32:6](https://ref.ly/Isa32:6) (לְדַבֵּר אֶל) [Ho 7:15](https://ref.ly/Hos7:15) (cf. [Na 1:9](https://ref.ly/Nah1:9)) [12:5](https://ref.ly/Hos12:5) וַיָּשַר אֶל־מַלְאָךְ and he strove *against* the angel. Here also belongs in partic. the phrase …הִנְנִי אֶל Behold I am *against* (thee, you, etc.) † [Na 2:14](https://ref.ly/Nah2:14), [3:5](https://ref.ly/Nah3:5), [Je 21:13](https://ref.ly/Jer21:13), ([23:30–32](https://ref.ly/Jer23:30-Jer23:32) על) [50:31](https://ref.ly/Jer50:31), [51:25](https://ref.ly/Jer51:25), Ez [13:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek13:8), [13:20](https://ref.ly/Ezek13:20), [21:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek21:8), [29:10](https://ref.ly/Ezek29:10), [30:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek30:22), [34:10](https://ref.ly/Ezek34:10), [35:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek35:3), [38:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek38:3), [39:1](https://ref.ly/Ezek39:1), ([5:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek5:8), [26:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek26:3), [28:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek28:22), [29:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek29:3) על: on [36:9](https://ref.ly/Ezek36:9) v. supr.) **5\.** *Unto* sometimes acquires from the context the sense of *in addition to,* as [Lv 18:18](https://ref.ly/Lev18:18) thou shalt not take אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחוֺתָהּ a woman *to, in addition to,* her sister, [Jos 13:22](https://ref.ly/Josh13:22) (‖ [Nu 31:8](https://ref.ly/Num31:8) על); [1 S 14:34](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:34) at eat אֶל־הַחָם *together with* the blood (v:[32](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:32) \& generally עַל); [1 K 10:7](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:7) הוֺסִיף אֶל (generally עַל); [Je 25:26](https://ref.ly/Jer25:26); Ez [7:26](https://ref.ly/Ezek7:26) שְׁמוּעָה אֶל שְׁמוּעָה (‖על); [44:7](https://ref.ly/Ezek44:7); [La 3:41](https://ref.ly/Lam3:41) let us lift up לְבָבֵנוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיִם our hearts *together with* the hands (cf. إِلَي, Qor 4:2; WAG ii. § 51 c). **6\.** Metaph. *in regard to, concerning, on account of :* thus הִתְאַבֵּל to mourn *concerning* [1 S 15:35](https://ref.ly/1Sam15:35); הִנָּחֵם to repent *as regards* [2 S 24:16](https://ref.ly/2Sam24:16); דָּרַשׁ to inquire [1 K 14:5](https://ref.ly/1Kgs14:5) הִתְפַּלֵּל to pray *with regard to* [1 S 1:27](https://ref.ly/1Sam1:27), [2 K 19:20](https://ref.ly/2Kgs19:20); צָעַק to cry [2 K 8:3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:3) (v:[5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:5) על); נֶעֳצַב be pained [1 S 20:34](https://ref.ly/1Sam20:34); נִחַם to comfort [2 S 10:2](https://ref.ly/2Sam10:2); more gen. [1 K 16:13](https://ref.ly/1Kgs16:13), [21:22](https://ref.ly/1Kgs21:22); אֶל־נֶפֶשׁ *on account of, for the sake of,* one's life [1 K 19:3](https://ref.ly/1Kgs19:3), [2 K 7:7](https://ref.ly/2Kgs7:7) ([Gn 19:17](https://ref.ly/Gen19:17) על). (עַל is more common in this sense.) And specially with verbs of saying, narrating, telling, etc. *with regard to,* as אָמַר [Gn 20:2](https://ref.ly/Gen20:2), [Is 29:22](https://ref.ly/Isa29:22), [37:21](https://ref.ly/Isa37:21), [37:33](https://ref.ly/Isa37:33) \+; דִּבֶּר [2 S 7:19](https://ref.ly/2Sam7:19), [Je 40:16](https://ref.ly/Jer40:16) b; סִפֵּר [Psalm 2:7](https://ref.ly/Ps2:7), [69:27](https://ref.ly/Ps69:27); צִוָּה [Is 23:11](https://ref.ly/Isa23:11); שָׁמַע Ez [19:4](https://ref.ly/Ezek19:4); הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֶל the report *regarding*… [1 S 4:19](https://ref.ly/1Sam4:19). (Not freq., ext. in the case of אָמַר.) **7\.** Of rule or standard, *according to* (rare): …אֶל־פִּי *according to* the command of, [Jos 15:13](https://ref.ly/Josh15:13), [17:4](https://ref.ly/Josh17:4), [21:3](https://ref.ly/Josh21:3) (generally עַל־פִּי); אֶל־נָבוֺן *according to* what is fixed \= of a certainty † [1 S 23:23](https://ref.ly/1Sam23:23), [26:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam26:4) (v. Dr): perh. [Psalm 5:1](https://ref.ly/Ps5:1), [80:1](https://ref.ly/Ps80:1) ([45:1](https://ref.ly/Ps45:1) עַל). **8\.** Expressing presence at a spot, *against; at, by,* not merely after verbs expressing or implying motion (cf. **1,** [Gn 24:11](https://ref.ly/Gen24:11)), as [Jos 11:5](https://ref.ly/Josh11:5) and they came and encamped together אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֺם *at* the waters of Merom, [1 S 5:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam5:4) cut off (and fallen) *on to* the threshold, [2 S 2:23](https://ref.ly/2Sam2:23) al. and smote him אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ *in* or *on* the belly, [Dt 33:28](https://ref.ly/Deut33:28), [Ex 29:12](https://ref.ly/Exod29:12), [Lv 4:7](https://ref.ly/Lev4:7); but also in other cases, as [Jos 5:3](https://ref.ly/Josh5:3) and he circumcised the Israelites אֶל *against, at* the hill of the foreskins, [22:11](https://ref.ly/Josh22:11) have built an altar אֶל גְּלִילוֺת הַיַּרְדֵּן *by* the districts of Jordan, Ju [12:6](https://ref.ly/Judg12:6), [2 S 3:32](https://ref.ly/2Sam3:32), [14:30](https://ref.ly/2Sam14:30) \& [18:4](https://ref.ly/2Sam18:4) אֶל־יַד *at* the side of (elsewhere לְיַד, עַל יַד), [1 K 13:20](https://ref.ly/1Kgs13:20) as they were sitting אֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָן *at* the table, [2 K 11:14](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:14) אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ *by* the king, [Je 41:12](https://ref.ly/Jer41:12) and found him *by* the great waters, etc., [46:10](https://ref.ly/Jer46:10) אֶל־נְהַר פְּרָת *by* the Euphrates, Ez [3:15](https://ref.ly/Ezek3:15), [11:11](https://ref.ly/Ezek11:11), [17:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:8), [31:7](https://ref.ly/Ezek31:7), [40:18](https://ref.ly/Ezek40:18), [43:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek43:3), [47:7](https://ref.ly/Ezek47:7), [48:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek48:12). **9\.** Prefixed to other preps. it combines with them the idea of *motion* or *direction to:* thus אֶל־אַחֲרֵי [2 S 5:23](https://ref.ly/2Sam5:23), [2 K 9:18](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:18), [9:19](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:19) סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרַי turn *to* behind me, [Zc 6:5](https://ref.ly/Zech6:5) (where אֶל is pleon., prob. due to clerical error; note יצא אל before \& after); אֶל־בֵּין *in between* Ez [31:10](https://ref.ly/Ezek31:10), [31:14](https://ref.ly/Ezek31:14); אֵל־בֵּינוֺת similarly Ez [10:2](https://ref.ly/Ezek10:2); ´אֶל־מִבֵּית לְ *to* (the part) *within* (v. sub בַּיִת), *in within* [Lv 16:15](https://ref.ly/Lev16:15), [2 K 11:15](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:15) ‖ have her forth *in within* the ranks; אֶל־מוּל v. מוּל; ´אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְ *unto* the south of [Jos 15:3](https://ref.ly/Josh15:3); ´אֶל־מִחוּץ לְ *to* the outside of [Lv 4:12](https://ref.ly/Lev4:12), [4:21](https://ref.ly/Lev4:21) \+ ; אֶל־נֹכַח *to* the front of [Nu 19:4](https://ref.ly/Num19:4); אֶל־תַּחַת Ju [6:19](https://ref.ly/Judg6:19), [1 K 8:6](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:6) al. (v. sub תַּחַת). *Note* I.—In [Gn 20:13](https://ref.ly/Gen20:13) אֶל־כָּל־הַמָּקוֺם אֲשֶׁר נָבוֺא ´שָׁמָּה אִמְרִי־לִי וג; [Nu 33:54](https://ref.ly/Num33:54) ´אֶל־אֲשֶׁר וג; [Pr 17:8](https://ref.ly/Prov17:8) (cf. [Dt 16:6](https://ref.ly/Deut16:6));—אֶל appears to be used by a species of attraction ; the idea of motion involved in the relative clause influencing illogically the beginning of the sentence and causing אֶל to be used instead of בְּ. In Ez [31:14](https://ref.ly/Ezek31:14) אֵלֵיהֶם, as pointed, can only be from אַיִל III or IV (q. v.); if the word be taken as the Pron. with suff. (Hi Ke), אֲלֵיהֶם must be read. *Note* 2\.—There is a tendency in Hebrew, esp. manifest in S K Je Ez, to use אֶל in the sense of עַל; sometimes אֶל being used exceptionally in a phrase or construction which regularly, and in acc. with analogy, has עַל; sometimes, the two preps. interchanging, apparently without discrimination, in the same or parallel sentences. Thus (*a*) [Jos 5:14](https://ref.ly/Josh5:14) וִיִּפֹּל אֶל־פָּנָיו; [1 S 13:13](https://ref.ly/1Sam13:13) אֶת־מַמְלַכְתְּךָ אֶל־יִשְרָאֵל ´הֵקִים י; [14:34](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:34) (v. sub **5**); [17:3](https://ref.ly/1Sam17:3) עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר (contr. עַל [Dt 11:29](https://ref.ly/Deut11:29)); [19:16](https://ref.ly/Deut19:16), [2 S 6:3](https://ref.ly/2Sam6:3), [20:23](https://ref.ly/2Sam20:23) (contr. [8:16](https://ref.ly/2Sam8:16)) [1 K 13:29](https://ref.ly/1Kgs13:29), [18:46](https://ref.ly/1Kgs18:46) (contr. [2 K 3:15](https://ref.ly/2Kgs3:15) על) [Je 35:15](https://ref.ly/Jer35:15), Ez [7:18](https://ref.ly/Ezek7:18). (*b*) Ju [6:37](https://ref.ly/Judg6:37) and upon (עַל) all the earth let there be dryness, v:[39](https://ref.ly/Judg6:39) let there be dryness *on* (אֶל) the fleece; [1 S 14:10](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:10) come up עָלֵינוּ, v:[12](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:12) come up אֵלֵינוּ; [16:23](https://ref.ly/1Sam16:23) \& [16](https://ref.ly/1Sam16:16); [16:13](https://ref.ly/1Sam16:13) \& [18:10](https://ref.ly/1Sam18:10) צָלַח אֶל, [10:6](https://ref.ly/1Sam10:6) al. צָלַח עַל; [25:17](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:17) evil is determined אֶל־אֲדֹנֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־בֵּיתוֺ; v:[25](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:25); [27:10](https://ref.ly/1Sam27:10); [2 S 2:9](https://ref.ly/2Sam2:9) וַיַּמְלִבֵהוּ אֶל וְעַל…וְעַל…וְעַל…וְאֶל…וְאֶל…; [3:29](https://ref.ly/2Sam3:29) …יָחֻלוּ עַל …וְאֶל [2 K 8:3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:3) \& [5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:5); [9:6](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:6) \& [3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:3); [Je 19:15](https://ref.ly/Jer19:15); [25:2](https://ref.ly/Jer25:2); [26:15](https://ref.ly/Jer26:15) ye lay innocent blood עֲלֵיכֶם וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזּאֹת; [27:19](https://ref.ly/Jer27:19), [28:8](https://ref.ly/Jer28:8), [33:14](https://ref.ly/Jer33:14), [34:7](https://ref.ly/Jer34:7), [36:31](https://ref.ly/Jer36:31), [37:13](https://ref.ly/Jer37:13), [37:14](https://ref.ly/Jer37:14), Ez [18:6](https://ref.ly/Ezek18:6), [18:11](https://ref.ly/Ezek18:11) \& [15](https://ref.ly/Ezek18:15), [21:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek21:12) etc. [Psalm 79:6](https://ref.ly/Ps79:6) ([Je 10:25](https://ref.ly/Jer10:25) על twice). It is prob. that this interchange, at least in many cases, is not original, but due to transcribers. Conversely, though not with the same frequency, עַל occurs where analogy would lead us to expect אֶל, or even in juxtaposition with אֶל, as [1 S 1:10](https://ref.ly/1Sam1:10) הִתְפַּלֵּל עַל to pray *to* (v:[26](https://ref.ly/1Sam1:26) אֶל); v:[13](https://ref.ly/1Sam1:13); [25:25](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:25) עַל…אֶל; [1 K 20:43](https://ref.ly/1Kgs20:43) וַיֵּלֶךְ עַל־בֵּיתוֺ ([21:4](https://ref.ly/1Kgs21:4) אֶל); [Is 22:15](https://ref.ly/Isa22:15), [Je 11:2](https://ref.ly/Jer11:2), [23:35](https://ref.ly/Jer23:35), [31:12](https://ref.ly/Jer31:12). Cf. DrSm i. 13, 13; ii. 8, 7; 15, 4\.

## I אֵל (id: BDB00476)

\[Str411] † I. אֵל **pr.pl.m. \& f.** \= the more usual אֵלָּה, *these* [1 Ch 20:8](https://ref.ly/1Chr20:8); with art. הָאֵל [Gn 19:8](https://ref.ly/Gen19:8), [19:25](https://ref.ly/Gen19:25), [26:3](https://ref.ly/Gen26:3), [26:4](https://ref.ly/Gen26:4), [Lv 18:27](https://ref.ly/Lev18:27), [Dt 4:42](https://ref.ly/Deut4:42), [7:72](https://ref.ly/Deut7:72), [19:11](https://ref.ly/Deut19:11). (Merely an orthogr. variation of אֵלָּה, and doubtless pronounced similarly; the kindred dialects have in genl. a dissyllabic form: v. sub אֵלֶּה. Written similarly in Ph., e.g. CIS 3:22, 14:5, 93:3 (האל), but ZMG1875, 240 (Neo\-Punic) אלא; in Plaut. Poen. v. I. 9 transliterated *ily;* Schroed.:Ph. Gr. p. 81, 160, 286 ff.)

## I אלה (id: BDB00480)

I. אלה (assumed as √ of אֵל, (אֱלוֺהַּ) אֱלֽהִים *god, God*, but question intricate, \& conclusions dub. It is uncertain whether אֵל \& אֱלֽהִים are from the same √. Following are the chief theories: **1\. a.** Thes makes אֵל \& אֱלֽהִים distinct, and both really primitive, but associates אֵל in treatment with אֵל *strong, Pt.* of √ אול; *strong*, acc. to Thes, being derived from mng. *be in front of;* (different order in Lex. Man., RobGes) ; **b.** אֵל \& אֱלֽהִים distinct; former fr. אול *strong;* latter pl. of אֱלֽהַּ from √ \[אלהּ] \= أَلِهَ (وَلِهَ) *go to and fro* in perplexity or fear, hence אֱלֽהַּ *fear* \& *object of fear*, reverence, *revered one;* أَلِهَ إِلَى \= פחד אל *trepide confugere ad* [Ho 3:5](https://ref.ly/Hos3:5); אלהים \= פחד [Gn 31:42](https://ref.ly/Gen31:42) \= מוֺרָא [Is 8:13](https://ref.ly/Isa8:13) DeGn 1887, 48 (cf. σέβασμα, postB. Heb. יִרְאָה NHWB; Aram. דַּחֲלָא CWB); so De following Fl in DeGn ed. 4, 57, cf. MV. **2\.** אֵל \& אֱלֽהִים possibly connected; אֵל \= *leader, lord*, fr. √ אול *be in front;* so NöMBAk 1880, 760 f; SBAk 1882, 1175 f. **3\. a.** אֵל \& אֱלֽהִים connected, \& both fr. a √ אלה (\= אלהּ) to which is assigned mng. *strong;* so Ew§ 146 d, 178 b (v. also Jahrbücher d. bibl. Wiss. x. 11, Bibl. Theol. ii. 330\); **b.** אֵל fr. √ אלה *strong* (not אלהּ), \& אֱלֽהִים expanded from אֵל, cf. pl. אֲמָהוֺת fr. אמה etc.; so Di on [Gn 1:1](https://ref.ly/Gen1:1); he supports mng. *strong* by ref. to phrase יֵשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי [Gn 31:29](https://ref.ly/Gen31:29) al.; **c.** similarly, אֵל, being very early \& common Shemitic word, formed pl. אלהים, fr. which sing. אֱלוֺהַּ was afterwards inferred, NesTheol. Stud. a. Württ., 1882, 243 (criticized by NöSBA l. c.). **4\.** אֵל (אֱלוֺהַּ, אֱלֽהִים disregarded) fr. √ אלה *stretch out to, reach after* (cf. prep. אֵל, אֱלִי, also אָלָה *swear*), God as *the one whom men strive to reach*, ‘das Ziel aller Menschensehnsucht und alles Menschenstrebens,’ LagOr. ii. 3; Gn 1882, 173 \= M 96\.—Cf. SpurrellHeb. Text of Gn., App. ii, where all these views are stated somewhat more fully, \& briefly criticized; on the use of אֵל \& אֱלֽהַּ in Shemitic languages vid., exhaustively, NöMBAk, SBAk, l. c.).

> \[Str410,1286,416,415] II. אֵל **n.m.** (also, in n.pr. אֶל, אֱלִי; Sam. אל, Ph. אל, אלן (i.e. prob. אֵלֽן), Sab. אל, DHMOr. Congr. Leiden, 1883, As. *ilu*, Dlw; perhaps also Ar., Aram. cf. Nöl. c.; on *goddess* אלת Ph. Palm. Nab. Sab. (also אלהת) DHMl. c; Ar. إِلَاهَة (pl. إِلَاهَات) Flkl. > \[Str419,449] † אֶלְדָּד **n.pr.m.** (*God has loved*, cf. Sab. ורראל DHMZMG 1883\. 15; v. also יְדִידְיָה) one of the elders [Nu 11:26](https://ref.ly/Num11:26), [11:27](https://ref.ly/Num11:27); prob. \= אֱלִידָד [Nu 34:21](https://ref.ly/Num34:21) where called a prince of Benjamin.—On n.pr. with אֵל cf. those with אָב \& אָח, \& esp. Nöl. c., v. p. 42, \& (Sab.) DHMEpigr. Denkm. 88\.

> \[Str420] † אֶלְדָּעָה **n.pr.m.** (*God has called*? cf. دعا Ar.) son of Midian [Gn 25:4](https://ref.ly/Gen25:4), [1 Ch 1:33](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:33).

> \[Str443] † אֶלְזָבָד **n.pr.m.** (*God has given*, cf. Θεόδωρος זַבְדִּיאֵל, זְבַדְיָה) **a.** one of David's band of Gadites [1 Ch 12:12](https://ref.ly/1Chr12:12). **b.** Korahite [1 Ch 26:7](https://ref.ly/1Chr26:7).

## II אָלָה (id: BDB00529)

\[Str422] † II. אָלָה **vb.** swear, curse (cf. I. אלה ? so Thes LagOr ii. 3\)—**Qal** *Pf.* [1 K 8:31](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:31) ( \= [2 Ch 6:22](https://ref.ly/2Chr6:22) all Vrss Th Bö Bä Kp reading וְאָלָה); אָלִית Ju [17:2](https://ref.ly/Judg17:2); *Inf. abs.* אָלֽה [Ho 4:2](https://ref.ly/Hos4:2); אָלוֺת [Ho 10:4](https://ref.ly/Hos10:4). **1\.** *swear, take oath* before God [1 K 8:31](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:31) ( \= [2 Ch 6:22](https://ref.ly/2Chr6:22)); in covenants [Ho 4:2](https://ref.ly/Hos4:2), [10:4](https://ref.ly/Hos10:4) (falsely). **2\.** *curse* Ju [17:2](https://ref.ly/Judg17:2). **Hiph.** *Impf.* וַיּאֶֹל [1 S 14:24](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:24); *Inf.* לְהַאֲלֽתוֺ [1 K 8:31](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:31) \= [2 Ch 6:22](https://ref.ly/2Chr6:22) *adjure, put under oath.*

> \[Str423] † אָלָה **n.f.** oath [Gn 26:28](https://ref.ly/Gen26:28) \+; sf. אָלָתִי, אָלָתוֺ [Gn 24:11](https://ref.ly/Gen24:11) \+ (4 t.); pl. אָלוֺת [Dt 29:20](https://ref.ly/Deut29:20) \+ (4 t). **1\.** *oath* in testimony [Lv 5:1](https://ref.ly/Lev5:1), [Nu 5:21](https://ref.ly/Num5:21), [5:21](https://ref.ly/Num5:21) (P) [Pr 29:24](https://ref.ly/Prov29:24); בא באלה *come into an oath* [Ne 10:30](https://ref.ly/Neh10:30); הביא באלה *bring into an oath* Ez [17:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:13); נשא אלה [1 K 8:31](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:31) ( \= [2 Ch 6:22](https://ref.ly/2Chr6:22)). **2\.** *oath* of convenant [Gn 24:41](https://ref.ly/Gen24:41), [24:41](https://ref.ly/Gen24:41), [26:28](https://ref.ly/Gen26:28) (J) [Dt 29:11](https://ref.ly/Deut29:11), [29:13](https://ref.ly/Deut29:13); בזה אלה *despise an oath* Ez [16:59](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:59), [17:16](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:16), [17:18](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:18), [17:19](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:19). **3\.** *curse (a)* from God [Nu 5:23](https://ref.ly/Num5:23) (P) [Dt 29:18](https://ref.ly/Deut29:18), [29:19](https://ref.ly/Deut29:19), [29:20](https://ref.ly/Deut29:20), [30:7](https://ref.ly/Deut30:7), [2 Ch 34:24](https://ref.ly/2Chr34:24), [Is 24:6](https://ref.ly/Isa24:6), [Je 23:10](https://ref.ly/Jer23:10), [Dn 9:11](https://ref.ly/Dan9:11), [Zc 5:3](https://ref.ly/Zech5:3); (*b*) from men [Jb 31:30](https://ref.ly/Job31:30), [Psalm 10:7](https://ref.ly/Ps10:7), [59:13](https://ref.ly/Ps59:13). **4\.** *execration* in the phrase היה לאלה *become an execration* [Nu 5:27](https://ref.ly/Num5:27) (P) [Je 29:18](https://ref.ly/Jer29:18), [42:18](https://ref.ly/Jer42:18), [44:12](https://ref.ly/Jer44:12).

> \[Str8381] † תַּאֲלָה sf. תַּאֲלָֽתְךָ, **n.f.** curse [La 3:65](https://ref.ly/Lam3:65).

## III אָלָה (id: BDB00532)

\[Str421] † III. \[אָלָה] **vb.** wail (Aram. אֲלָא, ܐܶܠܴܐ) only **Qal** *Imv.* fs. אֱלִי [Jo 1:8](https://ref.ly/Joel1:8) (v. אַלְלַי).

> \[Str451] † אַלְיָה **n.f.** fat tail of sheep, still accounted a delicacy in the East; (Mish. *id.* Targum, אַלְיְתָה, אַלִּיתָא, etc.; Ar. أَلْيَه:, cf. FlTWB i. 418 a) [Ex 29:22](https://ref.ly/Exod29:22), [Lv 3:9](https://ref.ly/Lev3:9), [7:3](https://ref.ly/Lev7:3), [8:25](https://ref.ly/Lev8:25) (all ‖חֵ֫לֶב); [9:19](https://ref.ly/Lev9:19), prob. also [1 S 9:24](https://ref.ly/1Sam9:24) for הֶעָלָיהָ v. Gei Dr (cf. TristramNat. Hist. Bib. ch. vi RiHWB Schafe SmithDict. Bib. Sheep).

> \[Str432] † אִלּוּ **conj.** (oft. in Mishnah; Aram. אִילּוּ, ܐܶܠܘܽ, ࠀࠋࠅ from אִין, ܐܶܢ, and לוּ) if, though, only in late Heb., [Ec 6:6](https://ref.ly/Eccl6:6), [Est 7:4](https://ref.ly/Esth7:4).

(*c*) with bare pf. in apod., in sense of *If* ... *had* ..., only [Dt 32:30](https://ref.ly/Deut32:30) אִם־לאֹ כִּי *were* it *not that* ..., [Psalm 73:15](https://ref.ly/Ps73:15). (לוּ is more usual in such cases.) (4\) with **inf.** once (si vera 1\.) [Jb 9:27](https://ref.ly/Job9:27) אִם אָמְרִי \= if I say (lit. if (there is) my saying).—Note that the vb. following אִם is often strengthened by the inf. abs., as [Ex 15:26](https://ref.ly/Exod15:26), [19:5](https://ref.ly/Exod19:5), [21:5](https://ref.ly/Exod21:5), [22:3](https://ref.ly/Exod22:3), [22:12](https://ref.ly/Exod22:12), [22:16](https://ref.ly/Exod22:16), [22:22](https://ref.ly/Exod22:22), Ju [11:30](https://ref.ly/Judg11:30), [14:12](https://ref.ly/Judg14:12), [16:11](https://ref.ly/Judg16:11) etc.; cf. DrSm i. 20, 6\.

> **b.** *Special uses:* (1\) repeated ... אִם אִם *whether* ... *or* (sive ... sive) [Ex 19:13](https://ref.ly/Exod19:13), [Dt 18:3](https://ref.ly/Deut18:3), [2 S 15:21](https://ref.ly/2Sam15:21); similarly וְאִם…אִם [Gn 31:52](https://ref.ly/Gen31:52), [Je 42:6](https://ref.ly/Jer42:6), Ez [2:5](https://ref.ly/Ezek2:5), [Ec 11:3](https://ref.ly/Eccl11:3), [12:14](https://ref.ly/Eccl12:14) (cf. ܐܢ… ܐܢ, ܘܐܢ… ܐܢ PS250; وَإِنْ… إِنْ \& وَإِمَّء… إِمَّاءβ). (4\) Nearly \= *when*— with the pf.: (*a*) of past, [Gn 38:9](https://ref.ly/Gen38:9), [Nu 21:9](https://ref.ly/Num21:9) וְרָאָה…וְהָיָה אִם־נָשַׁךְ and it used to be, *if* or *when* a serpent had bitten a man, that he would look, etc., Ju [6:3](https://ref.ly/Judg6:3), [Psalm 78:34](https://ref.ly/Ps78:34) (v. [Nu 36:4](https://ref.ly/Num36:4) (with the impf.) **c.** Compounded with other particles:—(*a*) בִּלְתִּי אִם *except if, except*, † [Gn 47:18](https://ref.ly/Gen47:18), Ju [7:14](https://ref.ly/Judg7:14), [Am 3:3](https://ref.ly/Amos3:3), [3:4](https://ref.ly/Amos3:4). (δ) עַד אִם †[Gn 24:19](https://ref.ly/Gen24:19), [24:33](https://ref.ly/Gen24:33), [Is 30:17](https://ref.ly/Isa30:17), [Ru 2:21](https://ref.ly/Ruth2:21), \& עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם †[Gn 28:15](https://ref.ly/Gen28:15), [Nu 32:17](https://ref.ly/Num32:17), [Is 6:11](https://ref.ly/Isa6:11), *until,* prop. *until if* or *when*. (ε) רַק אִם *if only* (v. sub רַק). אִם־לאֹ in Ez [3:6](https://ref.ly/Ezek3:6) b is very difficult. The Vrss render *If I had sent*, etc., implying לֻא for אִם־לאֹ (for Ew's אִם־לֻא \= אִלּוּ, q.v., is precarious): Ges Hi Co ‘but (אִם־לאֹ after a neg., cf. supr. [Gn 24:38](https://ref.ly/Gen24:38), [Psalm 131:2](https://ref.ly/Ps131:2)) unto *them* (Isr.) have I sent thee: *they* can understand thee’ (but *understand* is a dub. rendering of שָׁמַע אֶל). **2\. Interrog.part. a.** in direct qu.: (*a*) alone (not freq. and usually \= *Num?* expecting the answer *No*, esp. in a rhet. style): [Gn 38:17](https://ref.ly/Gen38:17), [1 K 1:27](https://ref.ly/1Kgs1:27); Ju [5:8](https://ref.ly/Judg5:8) מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח *was* there a shield to be seen or a spear ...? [Is 29:16](https://ref.ly/Isa29:16); and repeated [Am 3:6](https://ref.ly/Amos3:6), [Je 48:27](https://ref.ly/Jer48:27), [Jb 6:12](https://ref.ly/Job6:12). (formal); [Gn 17:17](https://ref.ly/Gen17:17) P (with an anacol.) shall a child ...? וְאִם־שָרָה הֲבַת־תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה תֵּלֵד *or* Sarah,—shall she that is 90 years old bear? [Pr 27:24](https://ref.ly/Prov27:24) (וְאִם after neg. clause), **b.** in oblique interrogation, *if, whether:* (*a*) alone, after verbs of seeing, inquiring, etc. [2 K 1:2](https://ref.ly/2Kgs1:2), [Je 5:1](https://ref.ly/Jer5:1), [30:6](https://ref.ly/Jer30:6), [Mal 3:10](https://ref.ly/Mal3:10), [Psalm 139:24](https://ref.ly/Ps139:24), Ct [7:13](https://ref.ly/Song7:13), [La 1:12](https://ref.ly/Lam1:12), [Ezr 2:59](https://ref.ly/Ezra2:59); once מִי יוֺדֵעַ אִם *who knoweth if* ...? i.e. (like *haud scio an*) *perhaps* [Est 4:14](https://ref.ly/Esth4:14) (older syn. מִי יוֺדֵעַ alone: see [2 S 12:22](https://ref.ly/2Sam12:22), [Jo 2:14](https://ref.ly/Joel2:14), [Jon 3:9](https://ref.ly/Jonah3:9)). (*b*) disjunctively אִם…הֲ [Gn 27:21](https://ref.ly/Gen27:21), [Nu 13:18–20](https://ref.ly/Num13:18-Num13:20); so וְאִם…אִם [Jos 24:15](https://ref.ly/Josh24:15). **c.** compounded with הֲ, הַאִם †[Nu 17:28](https://ref.ly/Num17:28) הַאִם תַּמְנוּ לִגְוֺעַ prob. an emph. *Num? Shall we ever* have finished dying? [Jb 6:13](https://ref.ly/Job6:13) difficult: perh. *Is it* that my help is not in me? (a forcible means of expressing that that which might be thought impossible is nevertheless the case); Hi as an aposiop., If my help is not in me (am I still to wait) ? (The view that הַאִם \= הֲלאֹ *nonne?* is inconsistent with the fact that אִם in a question has regularly the force of *Num?*)

## I אָמַן (id: BDB00590)

\[Str539,547] † I. \[אָמַן] **vb. confirm, support** (cf. Ar. أمُنَ, etc., v. infr.; Sab. אמן in deriv. \& n.pr. cf. CISiv. 1, 10 DHMZMG 1885,598; Aram. אֲמַן, ܐܡܢ in Haph. Eth. እምነ፡ As. in deriv.)—only **Qal** Pt. אֹמֵן—1\. as vb. *support,* *nourish* [2 K 10:1](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:1), [10:5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:5), [Est 2:7](https://ref.ly/Esth2:7), **2\.** as subst. *foster\-father* [Nu 11:12](https://ref.ly/Num11:12) (J) [Is 49:23](https://ref.ly/Isa49:23). **3\.** אֹמֶנֶת *foster\-mother, nurse* [Ru 4:16](https://ref.ly/Ruth4:16), [2 S 4:4](https://ref.ly/2Sam4:4). **4\.** אֹמְנוֺת *pillars, supporters of the door* [2 K 18:16](https://ref.ly/2Kgs18:16). Pt. *pass.* a. הָאֱמֻנִים *those brought up* (in scarlet) [La 4:5](https://ref.ly/Lam4:5). **b.** אֱמוּנִים intrans. *faithful* (as firm, stable) as subst. m. *faithful ones* [Psalm 12:2](https://ref.ly/Ps12:2) (\> LXX SyrVer al. *faithfulness*) [2 S 20:19](https://ref.ly/2Sam20:19) (cf. Ar. أَمَنَ *be faithful,* أَمَنَ *trust in,* أَمِنَ *be secure*); [Psalm 31:24](https://ref.ly/Ps31:24) *faithful ones* ´י *Keepeth,* ´אֱמוּנִים נֹצֵר י; but ´א is here taken by LXX Ri De Che as n. abstr. v. אֵמֻן. Niph. נֶאֱמַן [Pr 11:13](https://ref.ly/Prov11:13) \+ (6 t); Impf. יֵאָמֵן, יֵאָ֫מֶן [1 K 8:26](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:26) \+ (9 t.); Pt. נֶאֱמָן [Pr 25:13](https://ref.ly/Prov25:13) \+ ( 16 t. ) נֶאֱמָנָה [Is 1:21](https://ref.ly/Isa1:21) \+ ( 4 t.); נֶאֱמֶנֶת [Psalm 89:29](https://ref.ly/Ps89:29); נֶאֱמָנִים [Pr 27:6](https://ref.ly/Prov27:6) \+ (9 t.); נֶאֱמָנוֺת [Dt 28:59](https://ref.ly/Deut28:59). 1\. *carried* *by* *a nurse* [Is 60:4](https://ref.ly/Isa60:4). **2\.** *made* *firm, sure, lasting:* place [Is 22:23](https://ref.ly/Isa22:23), [22:25](https://ref.ly/Isa22:25); name [1 Ch 17:24](https://ref.ly/1Chr17:24); waters [Is 33:16](https://ref.ly/Isa33:16), [Je 15:18](https://ref.ly/Jer15:18); an event [Ho 5:9](https://ref.ly/Hos5:9); sickness [Dt 28:59](https://ref.ly/Deut28:59); mercy [Is 55:3](https://ref.ly/Isa55:3). **3\.** *confirmed, established,* *sure:* kingdom [2 S 7:16](https://ref.ly/2Sam7:16); house, dynasty [1 S 2:35](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:35), [25:28](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:28), [1 K 11:38](https://ref.ly/1Kgs11:38), [1 Ch 17:23](https://ref.ly/1Chr17:23); prophet Samuel [1 S 3:20](https://ref.ly/1Sam3:20); cf. word\-play אִם לֽא תַאֲמִינוּ לאֹ תֵאָמֵנוּ \= *if ye believe not* (have not firm confidence) *ye will not be confirmed* [Is 7:9](https://ref.ly/Isa7:9); וְתֵאָמֵנוּ ´הַאֲמִינוּ בי \= *believe in Yahweh and ye will be confirmed* [2 Ch 20:20](https://ref.ly/2Chr20:20). 4\. *verified,* *confirmed:* words of God [1 K 8:26](https://ref.ly/1Kgs8:26), [2 Ch 1:9](https://ref.ly/2Chr1:9), [6:17](https://ref.ly/2Chr6:17); his precepts [Psalm 111:7](https://ref.ly/Ps111:7); testimonies [Psalm 19:8](https://ref.ly/Ps19:8), [93:5](https://ref.ly/Ps93:5); covenant [Psalm 89:29](https://ref.ly/Ps89:29); words of men [Gn 42:20](https://ref.ly/Gen42:20) (E). 5\. *reliable, faithful, trusty:* persons [1 S 2:35](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:35), [22:14](https://ref.ly/1Sam22:14), [Jb 12:20](https://ref.ly/Job12:20), [Psalm 89:38](https://ref.ly/Ps89:38), [101:6](https://ref.ly/Ps101:6), [Pr 25:13](https://ref.ly/Prov25:13), [Is 8:2](https://ref.ly/Isa8:2), [Ne 13:13](https://ref.ly/Neh13:13); a city [Is 1:21](https://ref.ly/Isa1:21); האל הנאמן *the faithful* *God* [Dt 7:9](https://ref.ly/Deut7:9) cf. [Is 49:7](https://ref.ly/Isa49:7); נֶאֱמַן רוּחַ *faithful in spirit* (disposition) [Pr 11:13](https://ref.ly/Prov11:13); לְבָבוֺ נֶאֱמָן *his heart faith\-ful* [Ne 9:8](https://ref.ly/Neh9:8); עֵד אֱמֶת וְנֶאֱמָן *true and faithful witness* [Je 42:5](https://ref.ly/Jer42:5); נאמניס פצעי אוהב *faithful the wounds of a loving one* [Pr 27:6](https://ref.ly/Prov27:6); c. נֵת [Psalm 78:8](https://ref.ly/Ps78:8); עִם [Ho 12:1](https://ref.ly/Hos12:1); בְּ of thing [Psalm 78:37](https://ref.ly/Ps78:37); בְּכָל־בֵּיתִי *in all my house* (of Moses) [Nu 12:7](https://ref.ly/Num12:7) (E). ## אָמֵץ (id: BDB00611)

\[Str541,533] † \[אָמֵץ] **vb. be stout, strong, bold, alert** (acc. to LagBN 28 f. fr. earlier אָמֹץ cf. אֹמֶץ)—Qal. Pf. 3 pl. אָֽמְצוּ [2 S 22:18](https://ref.ly/2Sam22:18) \+ 2 t.; Impf. יֶאֱמָץ [Gn 25:23](https://ref.ly/Gen25:23) ; וַיֶּאֶמְצוּ [2 Ch 13:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr13:18) ; Imv. אֱמַץ [Jos 1:7](https://ref.ly/Josh1:7), [1 Ch 28:20](https://ref.ly/1Chr28:20); אֱמַָץ [Jos 1:6](https://ref.ly/Josh1:6); אֱמָץ [Dt 31:7](https://ref.ly/Deut31:7) \+ 3 t.; אִמְצוּ [Dt 31:6](https://ref.ly/Deut31:6) \+ 2 t.—**1\.** *be strong,* of a people [Gn 25:23](https://ref.ly/Gen25:23) (J); of personal enemies [2 S 22:18](https://ref.ly/2Sam22:18) \= [Psalm 18:18](https://ref.ly/Ps18:18); [Psalm 142:7](https://ref.ly/Ps142:7) (all sq. מִן of compar.); also (without מן) *prevail* [2 Ch 13:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr13:18). **2\.** *Imv. be bold* (alw. ‖חֲזַק, חִזְקוּ), [Dt 31:7](https://ref.ly/Deut31:7), [31:23](https://ref.ly/Deut31:23), [Jos 1:6](https://ref.ly/Josh1:6), [1:7](https://ref.ly/Josh1:7), [1:18](https://ref.ly/Josh1:18); (‖ id. \+ אַל־תִּירְאוּ וְאַל־תַּעַרְצוּ) [Dt 31:6](https://ref.ly/Deut31:6); ‖ id. \+ אַל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל תֵּחָת) [Jos 1:9](https://ref.ly/Josh1:9); (‖ id. \+ אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תֵּחָתּוּ) [Jos 10:25](https://ref.ly/Josh10:25), [1 Ch 22:13](https://ref.ly/1Chr22:13), [28:20](https://ref.ly/1Chr28:20), [2 Ch 32:7](https://ref.ly/2Chr32:7). **Pi.** *Pf.* אִמֵּץ [Dt 2:30](https://ref.ly/Deut2:30) etc.; *Impf.* יְאַמֵּץ [Am 2:14](https://ref.ly/Amos2:14) etc.; וַיְאַמֶּץ־לוֺ [Is 44:14](https://ref.ly/Isa44:14), 3 fs. sf. 3 ms. תְּאַמְּצֶנּוּ [Psalm 89:22](https://ref.ly/Ps89:22); 1 S. sf. אֲאַמִּצְכֶם [Jb 16:5](https://ref.ly/Job16:5) etc.; Imv. אַמֵּץ [Na 2:2](https://ref.ly/Nah2:2); אַמֵָּצוּ [Is 35:3](https://ref.ly/Isa35:3); אַמְּצֵָהוּ [Dt 3:28](https://ref.ly/Deut3:28); *Inf.* sf. אַמְּצוֺ [Pr 8:28](https://ref.ly/Prov8:28); *Pt.* מְאַמֶּ־ץ [Pr 24:5](https://ref.ly/Prov24:5); — **1\.** *make firm, strengthen,* sq. acc., of giving clouds their place [Pr 8:28](https://ref.ly/Prov8:28) (subj. ´י); of repairing temple [2 Ch 24:13](https://ref.ly/2Chr24:13); of physical vigour [Pr 31:17](https://ref.ly/Prov31:17) ´חָֽגְרָה בְעוֺז מָתְנֶ\+יהָ וַתְּא :וְרוֺעֹתֽיהָ (subj. אֵשֶׁת חַיִל); of strength for war כֹּחַ ´א [Na 2:2](https://ref.ly/Nah2:2) (‖חִזֵּק מָתְנַיִם [Am 2:14](https://ref.ly/Amos2:14) (subj. חָזָק); cf. [Pr 24:5](https://ref.ly/Prov24:5); of royal power [2 Ch 11:17](https://ref.ly/2Chr11:17) ‖חִזֵּק; cf. בִּרְכַּיִם כּשְׁלוֺת ´א [Is 35:3](https://ref.ly/Isa35:3); כֹּרְעוֺת ´בּ ´א [Jb 4:4](https://ref.ly/Job4:4) (both ‖חִזֵּק יָדַיִם רָפוֺת fig, of encouragement; so ´א alone [Dt 3:28](https://ref.ly/Deut3:28) (‖חִזֵּק) [Jb 16:5](https://ref.ly/Job16:5) (‖חשך q.v.); [Psalm 89:22](https://ref.ly/Ps89:22) (subj. ´וְרוֺעַ י); of support [Is 41:10](https://ref.ly/Isa41:10) (subj. ´י; ‖עזר, תמך;—De Che sub **2**). **2\.** *assure, secure* for one's self, alw. sq. ל \+ sf.; of carpenter appropr. tree [Is 44:14](https://ref.ly/Isa44:14); cf. of ´י appropri\-ating Isr. under fig. of bough. [Psalm 80:16](https://ref.ly/Ps80:16); under fig. of chosen man v:[18](https://ref.ly/Ps80:18). **3\.** sq. לֵבָב *harden, make obstinate* [Dt 2:30](https://ref.ly/Deut2:30) (subj. ´י; ‖הִקְשָׁה רוּחוֺ) [Dt 15:7](https://ref.ly/Deut15:7) (of unkind man); [2 Ch 36:13](https://ref.ly/2Chr36:13) (of king Zedekiah, ‖הִקְשָׁה אֶת־עָדְפּוֺ). **Hithp.** *Pf.* הִתְאַמֵּץ [1 K 12:18](https://ref.ly/1Kgs12:18) \= [2 Ch 10:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:18); *Impf.* וַיִּתְאַמְּצוּ [2 Ch 13:7](https://ref.ly/2Chr13:7); *Pt.* מִתְאַמֶּצֶת [Ru 1:18](https://ref.ly/Ruth1:18); **1\.** *strengthen oneself*, of con\-spirators [2 Ch 13:7](https://ref.ly/2Chr13:7) (sq. עַל). **2\.** *confirm oneself* in a, purpose, *be determined* [Ru 1:18](https://ref.ly/Ruth1:18) (sq. ל \+ Inf.) **3\.** *make oneself alert,* make haste [1 K 12:18](https://ref.ly/1Kgs12:18) \= [2 Ch 10:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:18) (sq. ל \+ Inf.) **Hiph.** *Impf. Juss. exhibit strength, be strong* וְיַאֲמֵץ, לִבֶָּךָ ´חֲזַק ויא [Psalm 27:14](https://ref.ly/Ps27:14), so also [31:25](https://ref.ly/Ps31:24).

[La 1:8](https://ref.ly/Lam1:8); mostly abs. but sq. אַ־ל Ez [9:4](https://ref.ly/Ezek9:4) (‖נֶאֱנָק) [21:12](https://ref.ly/Ezek21:12). **2\.** in physical distress [La 1:11](https://ref.ly/Lam1:11) (‖בִּקֵּשׁ לֶחֶם); [Ex 2:23](https://ref.ly/Exod2:23) sq. מִן *by reason of* (‖וָעַק). **3\.** *groan* of cattle (בְּהֵמָה) [Jo 1:18](https://ref.ly/Joel1:18).

## אֲנִי (id: BDB00658)

\[Str589] אֲנִי, אָָ֫נִי **pron. 1 s, comm.. I** (أَنَا, אֲֶנָא ܐܶܢܳܐ, አነ፡) [Gn 6:17](https://ref.ly/Gen6:17), [9:9](https://ref.ly/Gen9:9), [9:12](https://ref.ly/Gen9:12) \+ oft. Following a ptcp. as its subj. (to express mostly either a true present or the fut. instans) [Gn 18:17](https://ref.ly/Gen18:17) הַמְכַסֶּה אֲנִי *Am I hiding* from Abraham that which, etc., Ju [15:3](https://ref.ly/Judg15:3), [1 S 3:13](https://ref.ly/1Sam3:13), [Je 1:12](https://ref.ly/Jer1:12), [38:14](https://ref.ly/Jer38:14), [44:29](https://ref.ly/Jer44:29) (v. Dr§ 135, 4\). Appended to a verb, it expresses, in early Hebrew, a real emphasis, as Ju [8:23](https://ref.ly/Judg8:23) לאֹ אֶמְשֹׁל אֲנִי בָּכֶם *I* will not rule over you, [2 S 12:28](https://ref.ly/2Sam12:28) lest *I* take the city, [2 S 17:15](https://ref.ly/2Sam17:15) thus and thus did Ahitophel counsel, and thus and thus יָעַצְתִּי אָ֫נִי did *I* counsel; but in later Heb. It is sometimes pelonastc, [Ec 2:11](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:11), [2:15](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:15), [2:18](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:18), [2:20](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:20) \+. In response to a question, אָ֫נִי alone \= *I am, It is I,* [Gn 27:24](https://ref.ly/Gen27:24), Ju [13:11](https://ref.ly/Judg13:11), [1 K 18:8](https://ref.ly/1Kgs18:8) \+. With הֲֶ הַאֲנִי † [Is 66:9](https://ref.ly/Isa66:9). (Syn. אָנֹבִי, q.v.)

* **Associated Passages:** 2 Samuel 12:28; 1 Kings 18:8; Genesis 9:9; Ecclesiastes 2:15; Ecclesiastes 2:11; Genesis 27:24; Ecclesiastes 2:18; Isaiah 66:9; Genesis 9:12; Judges 8:23; Judges 15:3; Genesis 18:17; Jeremiah 1:12; Ecclesiastes 2:20; Judges 13:11; 2 Samuel 17:15; 1 Samuel 3:13; Jeremiah 38:14; Genesis 6:17; Jeremiah 44:29

## אָֽנֹכִ֫י (id: BDB00660)

\[Str595] אָֽנֹכִ֫י, אָנֶ֪כִי (once [Jb 33:9](https://ref.ly/Job33:9) אָֽנֹכִ֫י **pron. 1 s. comm.** I; [Gn 3:10](https://ref.ly/Gen3:10), [7:4](https://ref.ly/Gen7:4), [15:1](https://ref.ly/Gen15:1), [15:2](https://ref.ly/Gen15:2), [16:5](https://ref.ly/Gen16:5) \+ oft. With הֲ הֶאָנֹכִי † [Nu 11:12](https://ref.ly/Num11:12), [Jb 21:4](https://ref.ly/Job21:4). (As. *anâku,* Ph. \& Moab. אנך: not in Ar. Aram, Eth.; but *ku* appears as the affix of the 1 s. in the Eth. verb (e.g. *waladku* \= Heb. יָלַדְתִּי). אָנֹכִי and אֲנִי appear to be two parallel formations (both containing the element *ani* \[cf. the sf. نِيَ, נִי\-] or *ana,* \& one strengthened by the addition of the demonst. basis *Ku* \[prob. akin to ܟܳܐ כָּא, כֹּה *here*]: cf. Sta§ 179 WSG 95 f. 98–101\), of which, in most of the Sem. languages, one prevailed to the exclusion of the other, but which in Heb. maintained their place side by side.) In some cases אני and אנכי appear capable of being used indiffer\-ently; in others the choice seems to have been determined, partly by rhythmical considera\-tions, partly by a growing preference for אֲנִי among later writers. Thus when appended to the verb for emph. (whether with or without גַּם) the lighter form אֲנִי is nearly always used ( [Lv 20:5](https://ref.ly/Lev20:5), [26:24](https://ref.ly/Lev26:24), [26:32](https://ref.ly/Lev26:32), [Dt 12:30](https://ref.ly/Deut12:30), Ju [1:3](https://ref.ly/Judg1:3), [8:23](https://ref.ly/Judg8:23), [2 S 12:28](https://ref.ly/2Sam12:28), [17:15](https://ref.ly/2Sam17:15), [18:2](https://ref.ly/2Sam18:2), [18:22](https://ref.ly/2Sam18:22), [Je 17:18](https://ref.ly/Jer17:18), [21:5](https://ref.ly/Jer21:5), Ez [17:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek17:22), [Jb 13:2](https://ref.ly/Job13:2) \+; cf. the cases [Gn 27:34](https://ref.ly/Gen27:34), [1 S 25:24](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:24), [2 S 19:1](https://ref.ly/2Sam19:1), [1 K 1:26](https://ref.ly/1Kgs1:26), [Pr 23:15](https://ref.ly/Prov23:15)); on the contrary, in the emph. rhetorical style of Dt, אָנֹכִי is preferred (in the discourses, uniformly, exc. [12:30](https://ref.ly/Deut12:30), in acc. with usage just noted, \& [29:5](https://ref.ly/Deut29:5) in a standing expression; on [32:48](https://ref.ly/Deut32:48), [32:51](https://ref.ly/Deut32:51) (P) cf. infr.) So far as the usage of partic. books is concerned, in the Pent. (exc. Dt) אֲנִי is used in P (incl. H) always (about 130 t.) exc. [Gn 23:4](https://ref.ly/Gen23:4) (cf. Ez below); in JE אנכי is preferred, though not exclusively (81:48\). In S there are 50 instances of each form. Je has some 54 instances of אֶני 37 of אנכי. In later books the preponderance of אֲנִי is evident. ## אנת (id: BDB00680)

אנת (the root of the pron. 2 Pers. in Shemitic: أَنْتَ, አንተ፡ *anta;* f. أَنْتِ, አንቲ፡ *antī;* BAram. Kt אַנְתָּה (m.), Targum אַנְתְּ \& אַתְּ (both m. \& f.); Syr. ܐܰܢ̱ܬ݀, f. ܐܰܢ̱ܬ݀ܝ, the *n* being written but not pronounced; As. *atta*, f. *atti\-e* Dl:§ 55 a, the *nt* being merged in the double *t;* Heb. similarly. Pl. أَنْتُمْ, አንትሙ፡ f. أَنْتُنَّ, አንትን፡ Aram. אַנְתּוּן, ܐܰܢ̱ܬ݀ܘܢ, f. אַתִּין, ܐܰܢ̱ܬܷ݀ܝܢ; As. *attunu*).

FrMM 228; Sta§ 178 a (rd. 8 for 18\) **pron. 2 s.m.** thou (for *anta*, v. supr.; cf. נָתַּתָּ for נָתַנְתָּ) [Gn 3:11](https://ref.ly/Gen3:11), [3:19](https://ref.ly/Gen3:19) \+ oft. Written אַתָּ † [1 S 24:19](https://ref.ly/1Sam24:19), [Psalm 6:4](https://ref.ly/Ps6:4), [Jb 1:10](https://ref.ly/Job1:10), [Ec 7:22](https://ref.ly/Eccl7:22), [Ne 9:6](https://ref.ly/Neh9:6). Appended to a vb. for emph., [Ex 18:19](https://ref.ly/Exod18:19), [18:19](https://ref.ly/Exod18:19), [1 S 17:56](https://ref.ly/1Sam17:56) שְׁאַל אַתָּה inquire *thou*, [20:8](https://ref.ly/1Sam20:8), [22:18](https://ref.ly/1Sam22:18), [Is 43:26](https://ref.ly/Isa43:26) סַפֵּר אַתָּה. Added for the purpose of strengthening a gen. or accus. sf. [1 K 21:19](https://ref.ly/1Kgs21:19), [Pr 22:19](https://ref.ly/Prov22:19) (Ges§ 135\.2\).

## II אַף (id: BDB00717)

\[Str637] II. אַף **conj.** denoting addition, esp. of something greater, also, yea (so Ph. Aram. ܐܳܦ, אַף, אוֺף; cf. فَ). **1\.** very rare in plain prose (in which גַּם is more usual): [Gn 40:16](https://ref.ly/Gen40:16)\* (\*with pron., as rather often) I *also* in my dream, [Nu 16:14](https://ref.ly/Num16:14), [Dt 2:11](https://ref.ly/Deut2:11)\*, [2:20](https://ref.ly/Deut2:20)\*, [2 S 20:14](https://ref.ly/2Sam20:14), (v. Dr) [2 K 2:14](https://ref.ly/2Kgs2:14)\*, [Est 5:12](https://ref.ly/Esth5:12); more freq. in poetry, esp. as introducing emphatically a new thought [Dt 33:3](https://ref.ly/Deut33:3), [33:20](https://ref.ly/Deut33:20), [33:28](https://ref.ly/Deut33:28), [1 S 2:7](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:7), [Psalm 16:6](https://ref.ly/Ps16:6), [16:7](https://ref.ly/Ps16:7), [16:9](https://ref.ly/Ps16:9), [18:49](https://ref.ly/Ps18:49), [65:14](https://ref.ly/Ps65:13) they shout for joy, *yea*, they sing! [68:9](https://ref.ly/Ps68:9), [68:17](https://ref.ly/Ps68:17), [74:16](https://ref.ly/Ps74:16), [89:28](https://ref.ly/Ps89:28)\*, [93:1](https://ref.ly/Ps93:1), [Pr 22:19](https://ref.ly/Prov22:19)\*, [23:28](https://ref.ly/Prov23:28)\* \+; or in more elevated prose style, [Lv 26:16](https://ref.ly/Lev26:16)\*; [26:24](https://ref.ly/Lev26:24)\*; [26:28](https://ref.ly/Lev26:28)\*; [26:41](https://ref.ly/Lev26:41)\*; and 25 t. in the impassioned rhetoric of Is:2 ([40:24–48:15](https://ref.ly/Isa40:24-Isa48:15)), e.g. [40:24](https://ref.ly/Isa40:24), [41:10](https://ref.ly/Isa41:10), [41:26](https://ref.ly/Isa41:26), [42:13](https://ref.ly/Isa42:13), [43:7](https://ref.ly/Isa43:7), [43:19](https://ref.ly/Isa43:19), [46:11](https://ref.ly/Isa46:11) *yea*, I have spoken, I will *also* bring it to pass; I have purposed, I will *also* do it! [48:12](https://ref.ly/Isa48:12), [48:15](https://ref.ly/Isa48:15). Implying something surprising or unexpected, *even, indeed* [Jb 14:3](https://ref.ly/Job14:3), [15:4](https://ref.ly/Job15:4)\*. וְאַף *and also* [Lv 26:39](https://ref.ly/Lev26:39), [26:40](https://ref.ly/Lev26:40), [26:42](https://ref.ly/Lev26:42), [26:44](https://ref.ly/Lev26:44), [Dt 15:17](https://ref.ly/Deut15:17), Hb [2:15](https://ref.ly/Hab2:15), [Psalm 68:19](https://ref.ly/Ps68:19), [1 Ch 8:32](https://ref.ly/1Chr8:32)\* \= [9:38](https://ref.ly/1Chr9:38)\*, [2 Ch 12:5](https://ref.ly/2Chr12:5)\*, [Ne 2:18](https://ref.ly/Neh2:18), [13:15](https://ref.ly/Neh13:15); *and even* [Jb 19:4](https://ref.ly/Job19:4) וְאַף־אָמְנָם שָׁגִיתִי *and even* indeed (if) I have erred…With הֲ, הַאַף *indeed*…? *really*…? † [Gn 18:13](https://ref.ly/Gen18:13), [18:23](https://ref.ly/Gen18:23) wilt thou *indeed* sweep away the righteous with the wicked? v:[24](https://ref.ly/Gen18:24), [Am 2:11](https://ref.ly/Amos2:11), [Jb 34:17](https://ref.ly/Job34:17), [40:8](https://ref.ly/Job40:8). In contrast to a preceding thought (expressed or implied) *but, nay* (*imo*) [Psalm 44:10](https://ref.ly/Ps44:10), [58:3](https://ref.ly/Ps58:3); cf. Ju [5:29](https://ref.ly/Judg5:29)\*.

> **2\.** Expressing non\-existence: **a.** as subst. (mostly a rare poet. syn of אַיִן): [Is 34:12](https://ref.ly/Isa34:12) and all his princes יִהְיוּ אָפֶס shall become *nought,* ([41:29](https://ref.ly/Isa41:29); [41:12](https://ref.ly/Isa41:12) יִהְיוּ כְאַיִן וּכְאֶפֶס; [40:17](https://ref.ly/Isa40:17) מֵאֶפֶס וָתֹהוּ (‖כְּאַיִן) as made of *nought* and worthlessness are they accounted by him, [41:24](https://ref.ly/Isa41:24) (rd. פָּעָלְכָם מֵאָפֶס, ‖מֵאַיִן v. אֶפַע); [52:4](https://ref.ly/Isa52:4) and Asshur oppressed him בְּאֶפֶס *for nought.* **b.** as part. of negation, prop. *cessation of*. . ! (cf. …אֵין *nought of*...), very rare in prose ([2 S 9:3](https://ref.ly/2Sam9:3)), chiefly a poet. syn. of אֵין [Is 5:8](https://ref.ly/Isa5:8) עַד אֶפֶס מָקוֺם till there is *an end of* place \= till there is *no* place (cf. עַָד אֵין [Psalm 40:13](https://ref.ly/Ps40:13)), [Am 6:10](https://ref.ly/Amos6:10) (cf. אָֽיִן Ju [4:20](https://ref.ly/Judg4:20)), [Dt 32:36](https://ref.ly/Deut32:36) (hence, in prose, [2 K 14:26](https://ref.ly/2Kgs14:26)), [Is 45:6](https://ref.ly/Isa45:6) (cf. אָין [43:11](https://ref.ly/Isa43:11)) v:[14](https://ref.ly/Isa43:14) [46:9](https://ref.ly/Isa46:9), [54:15](https://ref.ly/Isa54:15); אֲנִי וְאַפְסִי עוֺד [Zp 2:15](https://ref.ly/Zeph2:15), [Is 47:8](https://ref.ly/Isa47:8), [47:10](https://ref.ly/Isa47:10) is prob. to be rendered, ‘I am, and *there is none besides*’ (so Ges Ew Di etc.), the י being ‘paragogic’ as in זוּלָתי etc. (Ges§ 90, 3 a Ew§ 211 b), cf. וְאֵין עוֺד [Is 45:5](https://ref.ly/Isa45:5), [45:6](https://ref.ly/Isa45:6), [45:18](https://ref.ly/Isa45:18), [45:21](https://ref.ly/Isa45:21); but acc. to De the י is sf. of 1 S ‘Iam, and *I am nought* besides’ (i.e. and I am nought besides my all\-sufficient self).—בְּאֶפֶס (like בְּאֵין, q.v.) *without*: [Pr 14:28](https://ref.ly/Prov14:28), [26:20](https://ref.ly/Prov26:20), [Jb 7:6](https://ref.ly/Job7:6), [Dn 8:25](https://ref.ly/Dan8:25). **c.** as adv. of limitation: (*a*) *only*: † [Nu 22:35](https://ref.ly/Num22:35) (cf. אַח v:[20](https://ref.ly/Num22:20)) [23:13](https://ref.ly/Num23:13). ## אפת (id: BDB00762)

אפת (meaning dub. √ whence Ar. إِفُتٌ *calamity,* \& also *wonder, portent;* acc. to Thes Ar. √ \= إِيفَ *suffer evil*).

68:b. אפת: but Thes612. Add. 72 del. אפת, and der. מוֺפֵת from √ ו″פ, so BaNB § 172 c; v. also, on افت as late by\-form of أفك, DBMacdonaldJBL xiv(1895\). 58 ff..

> \[Str775] † אַרְפַּכְשַׁד **n.pr.m.** 3rd son of Shem ´א [Gn 10:22](https://ref.ly/Gen10:22), [10:24](https://ref.ly/Gen10:24), [11:12](https://ref.ly/Gen11:12), [11:13](https://ref.ly/Gen11:13), [1 Ch 1:17](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:17), [1:18](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:18), [1:24](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:24); אַרְפַּכְשָׁד [Gn 11:10](https://ref.ly/Gen11:10), [11:11](https://ref.ly/Gen11:11); doubtless a geogr. name (deriv. \& mng. dub., Thesder. fr. أُرْفَةٌ *boundary* (stem أَرَفَ *define, limit*), cf. also Eth. አረፍት፡ *wall,* \+ כשׁד \= כֶּשֶד, i.e. *Chaldean;* so SchrCOT [Gn 10:22](https://ref.ly/Gen10:22) who identifies with *Babylonia* (cf. [Gn 11:12](https://ref.ly/Gen11:12) f. \& אוּר כַּשְדִּים v:[28](https://ref.ly/Gen11:28); v:[31](https://ref.ly/Gen11:31)); v. another interpr. DlPa 255; acc. to most \= *Arrapachitis* on Upper Zab, NE. Fr. Nineveh, As. *Arbaḫa*, Armen. *Albak* LagArmen. Stud. 55 \& reff. so Bo MV, Di [Gn 10:22](https://ref.ly/Gen10:22) LagSy i. 54 NöZMG 1882, 182; but As. *Arbaḫa* is unfavourable to this).
